raw.description:
G’day, we’re Mosh & Moshy.

Our mission is to get Aussies the best possible health outcomes through best-in-class health programs.

We know the current healthcare system isn’t meeting the needs of the modern Australian, and we reckon there’s a better, more holistic way. Our programs across hair loss, sexual health, skincare, mental health and weight management are easy, accessible and completely discreet.

More than a job

There’s nothing better than knowing the work you’re doing matters and makes a genuine difference. We’re pretty lucky that, at Mosh & Moshy, this is the norm rather than the exception.

We’re looking for two endorsed Nurse Practitioners to join our multidisciplinary clinical team and provide high-quality, evidence-based care at an advanced nursing level. Working remotely, you’ll help improve patients’ access to healthcare and support them throughout their treatment journey.

Reporting to our Clinical Operations Manager, you’ll combine strong clinical judgement with clear, compassionate communication to deliver a seamless telehealth experience.

What you’ll do

As a Nurse Practitioner, you’ll:

  • Consult with new and existing patients via telephone and video, providing education, clinical advice and support
  • Manage patients’ ongoing treatment plans, including assessing their response to treatment
  • Prescribe appropriate medications and adjust treatment where clinically indicated and within your scope of practice
  • Triage presenting symptoms and escalate or refer patients to the appropriate medical practitioner or pharmacist
  • Collaborate with medical practitioners, pharmacists, allied health professionals and our wider Clinical Operations team
  • Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation and uphold our clinical governance and code-of-conduct requirements
  • Share insights and feedback to continually improve our clinical systems, workflows and overall patient experience

Experience you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, you’ll have:

  • A completed Master of Nursing and current endorsement as a Nurse Practitioner with AHPRA
  • A current PBS prescriber number, or the ability to obtain one
  • Recent experience working as a Nurse Practitioner within primary healthcare
  • Strong clinical judgement and a commitment to safe, evidence-based, patient-centred care
  • Confident, clear and empathetic communication skills, particularly in telephone and video consultations
  • The ability to work effectively and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary clinical environment
  • Confidence navigating digital clinical platforms, documentation systems and telehealth tools
  • A proactive approach to identifying opportunities to improve patient care, systems and processes

What’s on offer

We hire people who share our values, believe in our mission and are passionate about the future of healthcare. Some of the reasons our team loves Mosh & Moshy include:

  • A fully remote role with the flexibility to work from home, within Australia
  • Meaningful work that makes a real, positive difference in patients’ lives
  • Plenty of opportunity to learn and grow as the company evolves
  • Access to up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Two additional paid company closure days each year
  • Two days of purpose leave for mental health or learning and development
  • Access to on-demand learning through Go1
  • EAP support and online wellbeing programs
  • ClassPass credit discounts
  • Discounts across a range of Mosh & Moshy products and services
  • A creative, friendly and collaborative team

Better, together

Everyone is different, and we think that’s what makes life interesting. We believe our differences generate better ideas, bring valuable perspectives and help us represent the people we care for.

If you’re excited by the opportunity but don’t tick every single box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Ready to Make a Real Impact? Join e-STORAGE!

Who We Are

Welcome to e-STORAGE, a proud member of the Canadian Solar Inc. (NASDAQ: CSIQ) family! We’re leading the way in designing, building, and integrating advanced battery energy storage systems for utility-scale projects. Our mission? To accelerate the world’s renewable energy transition and create a more sustainable, resilient energy future for everyone.

With our innovative SolBank lithium-iron phosphate battery technology and comprehensive project services, we’re not just building products we’re powering communities and making a difference worldwide.

e-STORAGE is a subsidiary of Canadian Solar and a leading company specializing in the design, manufacturing, and integration of battery energy storage systems for utility-scale applications. The Company offers its own proprietary LFP battery solution, comprehensive EPC services, and innovative solutions aimed at improving grid operations, integrating clean energy, and contributing to a sustainable future. e-STORAGE has successfully implemented over 3.3 GWh DC of battery energy storage solutions in various locations, including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and China. This significant accomplishment solidifies e-STORAGE's position as a key player in the global energy storage integration industry.
Currently, the Company operates two fully automated, state-ofthe-art manufacturing facilities with an annual production capacity of approaching 20 GWh. eSTORAGE is fully equipped to continue providing high-quality, scalable energy storage solutions and contribute to the widespread adoption of clean energy.

For additional information about e-STORAGE, visit www.csestorage.com

Canadian Solar was founded in 2001 in Canada and has been listed on NASDAQ since 2006. It is now one of the world's largest solar technology and renewable energy companies. Canadian Solar is a leading manufacturer of solar photovoltaic modules, provider of solar energy and battery storage solutions, and developer of utility-scale solar power and battery storage projects with a geographically diversified pipeline in various stages of development. Over the past 22 years, Canadian Solar has successfully delivered over 102 GW of premium-quality, solar photovoltaic modules to customers across the world. Likewise, since entering the project development business in 2010, Canadian Solar has developed, built, and connected over 9 GWp of solar power projects and over 3 GWh of battery storage projects across the world. Currently, the Company has approximately 700 MWp of solar power projects in operation, 8 GWp of projects under construction or in backlog (late-stage), and an additional 17 GWp of projects in advanced and early-stage pipeline. In addition, the Company has a total battery storage project development pipeline of 52 GWh, including approximately 2 GWh under construction or in backlog, and an additional 50 GWh at advanced and early-stage development. Canadian Solar is one of the most bankable companies in the solar and renewable energy industry.

For additional information about Canadian Solar, visit www.canadiansolar.com

We offers a competitive salary plus fully comprehensive benefits and performance bonus package based on an annual objective achievement. Our generous benefits package includes a 401(k) Retirement Plan, medical/dental/life/disability program, PTO and sick days.

The general pay range for this position is 120-170K DOE and geographical location. This range represents annual base salary only, without regard to location, and does not include bonus or other incentives or benefits that may apply. The pay range for this role is subject to change.

Canadian Solar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.


What It’s Like to Work Here

At e-STORAGE, you’re more than just an employee—you’re part of a team that values your ideas, your background, and your unique perspective. We believe that a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s the secret to our success. Here, you’ll find:

  • Integrity: We do what’s right, always.

  • Innovation: We encourage fresh thinking and bold ideas.

  • Quality: We take pride in delivering excellence, every time.

  • Customer Focus: We listen, we care, and we deliver.

  • Sustainability: We’re passionate about protecting our planet for future generations.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

  • Join a global leader in renewable energy, backed by over 23 years of Canadian Solar experience.

  • Work on projects that matter—helping to build a cleaner, greener world.

  • Thrive in a supportive, collaborative environment where your growth is our priority.

  • Enjoy a competitive salary and a generous benefits package.

Want to join here is what we are looking For

  • The right mix of education, experience, and skills for the role.

  • Great communication, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities.

  • A true commitment to safety, ethics, and sustainability.

Your Rewards

We offer a competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package—including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and more.

Position Description
As the Director of Sales, you will be responsible for driving new logo acquisition and revenue growth across health plans, employers, TPAs, consultants, and health systems.


This is a true hunter role focused on identifying, developing, and closing strategic enterprise opportunities within a complex healthcare landscape.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a proven track record of exceeding sales quotas through proactive prospecting, executive relationship development, and disciplined execution of complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes.


This individual must be comfortable getting into the details of sophisticated healthcare benefit and virtual care solutions, working closely with internal business partners and external stakeholders to design solutions that meet client needs.


This position owns the entire customer acquisition lifecycle, from prospecting and opportunity development through contracting, implementation support, and formal transition to Client Success. Success requires close collaboration with Product, Clinical, Network, Operations, Finance, Legal, Implementation, Marketing, and Client Success teams to develop customized solutions and navigate complex organizational structures.


The ideal candidate is a highly motivated self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, learns quickly, maintains a positive and team-oriented mindset, and has the persistence and resilience necessary to win highly competitive enterprise opportunities.


Essential Job Functions

  • Drive net-new logo acquisition within an assigned territory through strategic prospecting, executive relationship development, and disciplined pipeline management to meet or exceed annual revenue quotas.
  • Develop and execute territory and account strategies, buyer engagement plans, and opportunity-specific sales motions that create a clear path to close.
  • Lead complex, consultative sales processes involving clinical, operational, financial, technology, procurement, legal, and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop a deep understanding of prospect benefit strategies, plan designs, funding arrangements, member engagement challenges, and total cost of care objectives to position MDLive solutions effectively.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with health plans, employers, consultants, TPAs, health systems, brokers, and strategic partners.
  • Partner closely with Product, Clinical, Network, Operations, Finance, Legal, Implementation, Marketing, and Client Success teams to develop customized solutions and ensure successful execution throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Coordinate and lead internal deal teams, driving alignment, accountability, and timely execution from opportunity development through contracting, implementation readiness, and transition to Client Success.
  • Navigate complex organizational structures, procurement processes, stakeholder dynamics, and decision-making frameworks to advance opportunities and remove barriers to close.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, and opportunity management within Salesforce while providing visibility into deal progress, risks, and growth opportunities.
  • Develop pricing strategies, financial proposals, and business cases that align customer needs with MDLive's growth objectives.
  • Monitor competitive activity, market trends, virtual care innovations, and healthcare benefit developments to refine positioning and strengthen sales strategies.
  • Provide market feedback and customer insights to influence product development, pricing strategies, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Manage and develop assigned direct reports, including coaching, performance management, and professional development.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Demonstrated success meeting and exceeding enterprise sales quotas in healthcare, digital health, benefits, or virtual care markets.
  • Proven track record of acquiring net-new logos and building pipeline through proactive business development efforts.
  • Deep understanding of healthcare benefits, plan design, funding arrangements, and employer and health plan buying processes.
  • Strong knowledge of the virtual care, digital health, and healthcare benefits ecosystem.
  • Ability to manage complex, detail-oriented sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and extended purchasing timelines.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop customized client solutions and navigate operational, clinical, technical, and contractual requirements.
  • Established executive-level relationships within health plans, employers, consultants, TPAs, and healthcare organizations.
  • Strong executive presence with demonstrated success engaging C-suite decision makers.
  • Exceptional organizational, analytical, and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to rapidly learn new products, market dynamics, and healthcare trends.
  • Positive, collaborative, team-first mindset with a strong work ethic and high degree of accountability.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
  • Experience utilizing Salesforce and related sales technologies to maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline visibility.
  • Experience in utilizing AI tools on a day-to-day basis to support workflows and to create efficiencies.
  • Ability to work effectively across complex organizations and influence outcomes without direct authority.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of enterprise healthcare sales experience, preferably within virtual care, digital health, health plans, healthcare benefits, or employer solutions.
  • Demonstrated success selling to health plans, large employers, consultants, TPAs, and healthcare organizations.
  • Proven history of achieving or exceeding annual sales quotas and revenue targets.
  • Experience selling solutions that require coordination across clinical, operational, financial, technology, and executive stakeholder groups.
  • Experience with provider network strategy or network contracting is strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing opportunities through implementation and client transition processes preferred.

Travel Requirements

Up to 40%


If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

About Evernorth Health Services

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, age, disability, sex, childbirth (including pregnancy) or related medical conditions including but not limited to lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital or familial status, genetic information, status with regard to public assistance, citizenship status or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal employment opportunity laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete the online application process, please email for assistance. Please note that this email inbox is dedicated to accommodation requests only and cannot provide application updates or accept resumes.

The Cigna Group has a tobacco-free policy and reserves the right not to hire tobacco/nicotine users in states where that is legally permissible. Candidates in such states who use tobacco/nicotine will not be considered for employment unless they enter a qualifying smoking cessation program prior to the start of their employment. These states include: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nebraska, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Vermont, and Washington State.

Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with all federal, state and local ordinances.

Maintenance & Property Operations Coordinator

Company: Corporate Stays

Department: Operations

Job Type: Full-Time Freelancer

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Working Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Montreal time
Reports To: COO

About Corporate Stays

Corporate Stays provides furnished accommodations for business travelers, professionals, and extended stays. Our Canadian operations focus on delivering comfortable, well-maintained properties and a reliable guest experience.

We work with local technicians, contractors, building management teams, and internal departments to ensure our properties remain safe, functional, and ready for guests.

Position Overview

The Maintenance & Property Operations Coordinator will oversee maintenance requests and coordinate repair activities across Corporate Stays' Canadian property portfolio.

This role is responsible for coordinating local technicians and contractors, prioritizing urgent maintenance issues, tracking repair costs and deadlines, and verifying that work is completed to the required standards. The coordinator will also support preventive maintenance planning, maintain accurate maintenance records, and work closely with the Concierge Department and building management teams to minimize disruptions to guest stays.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, cost-conscious, and experienced in coordinating external service providers remotely.

Goal of the Position

To ensure maintenance issues across the Canadian portfolio are addressed promptly, repairs are completed efficiently and within budget, and properties remain in good operating condition while minimizing guest disruption and recurring maintenance problems.

Main Responsibilities

  • Monitor and manage maintenance requests across Corporate Stays' Canadian property portfolio.
  • Coordinate local technicians, contractors, and maintenance providers to ensure timely completion of repairs.
  • Ensure urgent maintenance issues receive immediate attention and are escalated when necessary.
  • Obtain, review, and compare contractor quotations to support cost-effective decisions.
  • Track repair costs, work progress, and completion deadlines.
  • Verify completed work through photographs, videos, or independent confirmation when necessary.
  • Coordinate with building management companies regarding access, keys, elevators, building regulations, and other property-related requirements.
  • Implement and maintain preventive maintenance schedules to reduce unexpected repairs.
  • Identify recurring technical problems and recommend permanent solutions to prevent repeated issues.
  • Develop and maintain a reliable database of contractors and service providers in each Canadian city.
  • Coordinate with the Concierge Department when maintenance issues may affect guest stays, check-ins, or the overall guest experience.
  • Track maintenance expenses and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Maintain complete and accurate maintenance records in Breezeway or the designated operational system.
  • Follow up on open and overdue maintenance tickets to ensure accountability and timely resolution.
  • Provide regular updates on urgent incidents, outstanding repairs, contractor performance, and maintenance costs.
  • Ensure maintenance activities follow company procedures and applicable property requirements.

Performance Goals (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on the following indicators:

  • Urgent Maintenance Response Time: Average time taken to respond to urgent maintenance requests.
  • Maintenance Resolution Time: Average time required to resolve maintenance tickets.
  • On-Time Completion Rate: Percentage of maintenance tasks completed within the established SLA.
  • Recurring Maintenance Issues: Number of repeated technical or repair issues across the portfolio.
  • Maintenance Cost per Apartment: Average maintenance expenditure per apartment.
  • Overdue Maintenance Tickets: Number of maintenance requests that remain unresolved past their deadlines.

Qualifications

  • Experience in property management, facilities coordination, hospitality maintenance, or a similar role.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating external contractors and service providers remotely.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to prioritize urgent incidents and coordinate timely responses.
  • Experience using task management systems and property management software.
  • Understanding of basic building maintenance, repair processes, and contractor coordination.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to track expenses, compare quotations, and support cost-effective maintenance decisions.
  • Ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously while maintaining accurate records and clear communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Breezeway, Hostaway, Guesty, or similar property management and operational platforms.
  • Experience coordinating maintenance across multiple properties or cities.
  • Familiarity with building management procedures, contractor scheduling, property access requirements, and preventive maintenance programs.
  • Experience working with hospitality or furnished rental operations.

Success Profile

The successful candidate is proactive, organized, resourceful, and comfortable managing multiple maintenance requests across different locations. They can distinguish urgent issues from routine repairs, coordinate reliable contractors, monitor costs, and ensure work is completed and properly documented.

Success in this role means faster maintenance response and resolution times, fewer overdue and recurring issues, better control of repair expenses, stronger contractor accountability, and minimal disruption to the guest experience.

raw.description:
ABOUT US

Contáctica is the leading Martech Creative Agency in Puerto Rico, a strong challenger in Latin America, and a dynamic catalyst for growth in the U.S. mainland. For over 20 years, we have challenged the status quo and accelerated the evolution of visionary companies and their teams by delivering pioneering knowledge, transformative Martech solutions, and full-spectrum marketing agency services.

With headquarters in Puerto Rico and Colombia, and a closely integrated team working across ten countries, we are uniquely positioned to serve key industries such as Banking, Insurance, and Consumer Packaged Goods (CPGs), while tackling the most complex brand, product, and business challenges of today and tomorrow.

As we continue into a new era of Hyper-Evolution, we are passionately committed to driving growth and innovation by leveraging the Power of Humanity + Artificial Intelligence. Our unwavering focus remains unchanged: to deliver exceptional business outcomes through strategic thinking, creativity, and deep client insight, augmented by cutting-edge technologies.

If you share our beliefs—and are committed to acting on them fully—we invite you to review the requirements of this position and consider applying.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for a visionary, strategically minded, and technology-forward Creative Director to lead the conceptual, creative, and technological development of our assigned brands.

This role is responsible for transforming complex business and communication challenges into relevant, innovative, and executable ideas that deliver measurable value for our clients. The ideal candidate combines exceptional conceptual thinking, strong creative leadership, digital fluency, and a deep understanding of how Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies are transforming the creative process.

The Creative Director will lead Associate Creative Directors, Copywriters, Content Creators, and strategic creative partners, while guiding multidisciplinary teams that may include Designers, Motion Designers, AI Specialists, Creative Developers, and Production Partners.

Working closely with the Chief Creative Officer, the Head of Art & AI Leader, and the Audiovisual General Producer & AI Leader, this person will turn the company’s creative vision into concrete solutions that combine strategic relevance, creative excellence, and technological feasibility.

This is not a role in which Artificial Intelligence is viewed solely as a production tool. We are looking for someone who understands that technology can also become the origin of an idea, an experience, a product, or a new business solution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the conceptual development of integrated campaigns, content platforms, digital experiences, and special projects.
  • Transform business challenges, consumer insights, and strategic briefs into simple, relevant, memorable, and executable creative ideas.
  • Ensure the conceptual quality, creative consistency, and executional excellence of all work developed by the assigned teams.
  • Translate the creative vision established by the Chief Creative Officer into concrete solutions for clients and brands.
  • Incorporate Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies from the earliest stages of the creative process.
  • Identify opportunities where AI can become an integral part of the concept, customer experience, product, or business solution—not only a tool for accelerating production.
  • Explore new technologies and creative methodologies that enable the development of ideas that would be difficult or impossible to execute through traditional processes.
  • Design and implement specialized AI agents to support creative research, insight generation, content development, production, workflow management, and knowledge sharing.
  • Develop and maintain reusable libraries of prompts, agents, methodologies, and automated workflows for the creative department.
  • Build intelligent workflows using automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier to improve productivity, consistency, and scalability.
  • Use AI-assisted research tools to accelerate benchmarking, competitive analysis, trend identification, cultural exploration, and insight discovery.
  • Lead the development of relevant creative insights, even when a project does not require a formal strategy workstream.
  • Create rapid prototypes and proof-of-concept executions to evaluate ideas before entering full production.
  • Understand how creativity connects across CRM, Social Media, Paid Media, Websites, E-commerce, Marketing Automation, Customer Journeys, and Conversational AI.
  • Collaborate closely with Strategy, Accounts, Media, Technology, Production, and Project Management teams to ensure that ideas are strategically relevant and operationally viable.
  • Partner with the Creative Intelligence Lead to strengthen brand platforms, communication frameworks, creative methodologies, and award narratives.
  • Build compelling stories and narratives for campaigns, products, content ecosystems, digital experiences, and client presentations.
  • Lead creative presentations and defend ideas with clarity, strategic reasoning, confidence, and the ability to inspire clients and internal teams.
  • Act as a trusted creative and innovation advisor for assigned clients and brands.
  • Anticipate creative, technological, operational, and reputational risks and address them with sound judgment and professionalism.
  • Lead, inspire, mentor, and develop Associate Creative Directors, Copywriters, Content Creators, and other multidisciplinary talent.
  • Provide clear, continuous, and actionable feedback that raises the quality of the work and supports professional growth.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, experimentation, continuous learning, and creative ambition.
  • Participate in talent selection, onboarding, development planning, and performance evaluation processes.
  • Coordinate and evaluate external specialists and strategic partners in creativity, Artificial Intelligence, automation, technology, development, and production.
  • Ensure that external partners meet the creative, technical, operational, and quality standards required by each project.
  • Document and share methodologies, experiments, prompts, agents, workflows, case studies, and best practices across the creative department.
  • Contribute to the development of new creative capabilities, technology-enabled services, and differentiated solutions for clients.
  • Participate actively in new business opportunities, pitches, and strategic proposals.
  • Identify campaigns and projects with the potential to become successful case studies or award submissions.
  • Collaborate on the conceptual development and storytelling of entries for national and international creative festivals.
  • Represent and live Contáctica’s values in every interaction with clients, teams, partners, and suppliers.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven experience as a Creative Director, Associate Creative Director, or in a comparable senior creative leadership role.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating outstanding conceptual thinking, integrated campaign development, storytelling, and creative execution.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams and developing creative talent.
  • Strong ability to transform business challenges, strategic briefs, consumer insights, and cultural trends into relevant creative solutions.
  • Solid understanding of branding, advertising, content, digital experiences, social platforms, and integrated marketing ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated experience incorporating Artificial Intelligence into creative research, ideation, content development, production, or workflow optimization.
  • Hands-on knowledge of leading generative AI and research platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, Sora, and ElevenLabs.
  • Ability to determine which AI platform, model, or technological solution is most appropriate for a specific creative objective.
  • Experience designing advanced prompts, structured prompt systems, or conversational architectures that generate consistent and scalable results.
  • Experience designing, configuring, or implementing specialized AI agents for research, creativity, production, automation, or knowledge management.
  • Functional knowledge of automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier.
  • Understanding of how CRM, Social Media, Paid Media, Websites, E-commerce, Marketing Automation, Customer Journeys, and Conversational AI connect within a client’s digital ecosystem.
  • Ability to use AI-assisted research to conduct benchmarking, competitive analysis, trend exploration, and insight discovery.
  • Strong presentation, storytelling, communication, and idea-selling skills.
  • Ability to defend creative recommendations with strategic reasoning while remaining open to feedback and collaboration.
  • Strong client-facing skills and the ability to act as a trusted advisor in creativity, innovation, and emerging technology.
  • Experience working with external production partners, technology specialists, developers, and creative suppliers.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong interest in developing new services, products, methodologies, and client solutions.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound decisions, and maintain creative excellence in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong curiosity and a continuous-learning mindset regarding creativity, culture, consumer behavior, Artificial Intelligence, technology, and innovation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Advertising, Design, Communications, Marketing, Creative Technology, or a related field.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.

START THE JOURNEY

If you share our beliefs—and are committed to act on them fully—we invite you to apply to join our team and experience the thrill of working in a fast-paced, cutting-edge, mostly remote environment.

Apply here and start the journey. Please include a personal letter with your application explaining why you're the best person for this position.

We are Contáctica, a technology and creativity company tackling the most complex brand, product, and business challenges of today and tomorrow while serving key industries such as banking, insurance, and consumer packaged goods (CPGs).

Rust Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Rust Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $145,000–$205,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Rust Developer to design, build, and optimize high-performance distributed systems, low-latency backend services, and cloud-native infrastructure components powering mission-critical enterprise platforms. This role focuses on developing highly concurrent, memory-safe applications using Rust while integrating with modern cloud environments, container orchestration platforms, and event-driven architectures.
You will work closely with platform engineers, distributed systems architects, DevOps teams, and product engineering groups to build scalable APIs, asynchronous processing pipelines, networking services, and infrastructure automation tools. The ideal candidate has strong systems programming expertise, deep knowledge of concurrent application development, and experience building production software where performance, reliability, and security are critical.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop high-performance backend services using Rust for large-scale distributed systems.
  • Build low-latency APIs, asynchronous processing services, and event-driven microservices.
  • Develop networking applications utilizing TCP, UDP, HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSockets, and QUIC protocols.
  • Build highly concurrent applications using Rust's async ecosystem including Tokio and async/await.
  • Design resilient services capable of processing millions of transactions with high availability and fault tolerance.
  • Optimize CPU utilization, memory management, thread scheduling, and application performance.
  • Integrate services with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams, or other enterprise messaging platforms.
  • Develop secure APIs and authentication services supporting OAuth2, JWT, OpenID Connect, and mTLS.
  • Build observability capabilities including structured logging, distributed tracing, and performance monitoring.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, system design discussions, and production support.
  • Collaborate with DevOps engineers to automate deployments using CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Investigate complex production issues involving networking, concurrency, memory utilization, and distributed systems.

Required Skills
  • Six or more years of professional software engineering experience building enterprise applications.
  • Three or more years of hands-on Rust development experience in production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Rust programming language, ownership model, borrowing, lifetimes, traits, generics, and macros.
  • Extensive experience with asynchronous Rust development using Tokio, async/await, Futures, and Actix or Axum.
  • Strong understanding of concurrent programming, multithreading, synchronization primitives, and lock-free programming concepts.
  • Experience building RESTful APIs, gRPC services, and high-performance backend applications.
  • Strong understanding of operating system fundamentals including memory management, process scheduling, file systems, and networking.
  • Experience working with Linux production environments and command-line tooling.
  • Experience developing cloud-native applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong SQL skills with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
  • Experience working with NoSQL databases such as Redis, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or MongoDB.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience integrating distributed messaging systems including Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, or Pulsar.
  • Strong debugging, profiling, benchmarking, and performance optimization skills.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building distributed systems supporting high-throughput financial, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or telecommunications platforms.
  • Familiarity with Rust web frameworks including Axum, Warp, Rocket, or Actix Web.
  • Experience developing Kubernetes Operators or cloud-native infrastructure tooling.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Pulumi.
  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and distributed tracing platforms.
  • Knowledge of cryptographic libraries, TLS, secure communications, and certificate management.
  • Experience building command-line tools and systems utilities using Rust.
  • Familiarity with C/C++ interoperability through Foreign Function Interface (FFI).
  • Contributions to open-source Rust projects or participation in the Rust community are highly desirable.

Project Environment
You will be joining a platform engineering team responsible for building next-generation distributed infrastructure supporting enterprise-scale applications across cloud environments. Current initiatives include:
  • High-performance API gateway and service mesh components
  • Real-time event streaming and data processing pipelines
  • Distributed job scheduling and workflow orchestration services
  • Cloud-native platform services deployed on Kubernetes
  • Secure authentication and identity management infrastructure
  • Infrastructure automation and systems observability platforms
  • High-availability backend services processing millions of requests daily
  • Enterprise monitoring, telemetry, and reliability engineering solutions

This is a highly technical engineering role where you will contribute to architecture, implementation, performance optimization, deployment, and operational excellence for large-scale production systems.

How to Apply

Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 676-4399. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .

Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

BV Teck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination. Any improper interference with employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.

raw.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $125k - $145k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Prattville, Alabama

Salary:

125K - 145K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Make an Impact While Building Your Career

Are you an experienced Customer Service Representative, Call Center Agent, or Contact Center Professional who thrives in a fast-paced, high-volume environment? Do you excel at handling complex customer interactions, critical calls, and time-sensitive situations with professionalism and urgency?

We are seeking motivated, detail-oriented professionals with backgrounds in banking, insurance, healthcare, legal services, paralegal support, front desk and administrative reception, hospitality, utilities, telecommunications, and emergency dispatch to join our fully remote team.

This is an opportunity to use your communication, problem-solving, and multitasking skills to support public safety initiatives across South Carolina while working from home.

Previous remote/work-from-home customer service or virtual call center experience is strongly encouraged.

What Makes This Role Different?

We DO NOT handle:

  • Collections
  • Telemarketing
  • Cold calling
  • Door-to-door sales

Instead, our team supports critical public safety communication services that help prevent damage to underground utilities and protect communities throughout South Carolina.

About Us

SC811 is South Carolina’s “Call Before You Dig” contact center. We help homeowners, contractors, excavators, and businesses submit locate requests before digging or excavation begins.

Our work helps prevent:

  • Utility outages
  • Property damage
  • Service interruptions
  • Workplace accidents
  • Serious injuries and fatalities

Safety, accuracy, and exceptional customer service are at the core of everything we do.

Description:

The Customer Service Representative is responsible for managing a high volume of inbound calls while accurately documenting excavation and utility locate information in a web-based system. The candidate must possess excellent verbal and written communication skills. In addition, maintain a positive & professional attitude when handling calls, with a sense of urgency. Be able to accurately plot site locations on a map. This position is open to candidates in South Carolina and is fully remote. The company will provide the needed equipment.

This role requires:

  • Strong active listening skills
  • Accurate data entry
  • Excellent verbal communication
  • Calmness under pressure
  • Critical thinking
  • Ability to manage difficult or complex customer situations
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced call center environment

Key Responsibilities:

  • Accurately record data from the caller on inbound telephone lines and process notices. Individuals must also accurately provide the caller with pertinent and legally required information for each locate notice.
  • Handle high-volume inbound customer service calls with professionalism and urgency
  • Accurately collect, document, and process excavation locate requests
  • Provide callers with legally required and safety-related information
  • Navigate multiple computer systems and web-based applications simultaneously
  • Maintain exceptional attention to detail while multitasking
  • De-escalate difficult customer interactions and resolve concerns effectively
  • Plot and verify excavation site locations using mapping tools
  • Meet productivity, quality assurance, and performance metrics in a call center environment
  • Support operational efficiency and public safety initiatives
  • Maintain confidentiality and compliance with company procedures
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by leadership

Skills/Requirements:

  • Be able to type at least 45 wpm accurately (or at least 14,500 kph)
  • Able to process excavation information precisely and adhere to standards set forth by the Company
  • Ability to understand and listen effectively to customer situations while maintaining company interests
  • Handle a high volume of telephone contacts that may include difficult and demanding customer situations
  • Have effective time management skills and manage work in a fast-paced environment
  • Handle repetition of tasks throughout the workday
  • Score acceptable or set goals on evaluations composed by Management.

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to stand or sit for considerable lengths of time.

  • Must be willing to undergo a background check, in accordance with local law/regulations.

  • 2 years of customer service experience required
  • Be able to pass an assessment test for typing and customer service skills
  • Must have minimum internet speeds required: 3 Mbps upload/10 Mbps download (Company will provide a link to a test to confirm)
  • Bilingual candidates encouraged to apply
  • Must reside and be able to work remotely from within the State of South Carolina.

raw.excerpt: OverviewThe Clinical Resilience and Preparedness Director is responsible for developing, leading and sustaining the organization's enterprise strategy for managing extended unplanned downtime of critical clinical systems and applications.
raw.description:
Overview

The Clinical Resilience and Preparedness Director is responsible for developing, leading and sustaining the organization's enterprise strategy for managing extended unplanned downtime of critical clinical systems and applications.

This leadership role will ensure the clinical readiness for the organization in the event that Epic or any critical clinical application system goes down and that patient care can continue with minimal disruption. The Clinical Resilience and Preparedness Director will oversee the preparedness, documentation response & recovery and business continuity planning activities for the health system. This leader will work across teams and disciplines, partnering with executive leadership, clinical operations, IT, Epic, Cyber, Risk Management, Compliance, Revenue Cycle, HIM, Marketing and our Community Connect partners to ensure clinical downtime readiness.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with executive leadership, clinical operations, IT, Epic, Cyber, Risk Management, Compliance, Revenue Cycle,HIM Marketing and our Community Connect partners
  • Ensure clinical downtime readiness in the event of a system outage of major clinical applications, including Epic.
  • Establish a readiness strategy for our workforce and Community Connect partners.
  • Ensure Clinical Downtime Readiness
  • Standardized downtime procedures across all hospitals and ambulatory areas.
  • Ensure paper chart packets readily available in all inpatient units, ambulatory offices and procedure areas.
  • Oversee downtime procedures including workflows for order entry, positive patient identification, radiology and lab requisitions, admission/discharge/transfer bed management and other clinical care processes
  • Ensure safe patient care when core clinical IT systems are unavailable.
  • Responsible for the ongoing creation, standardization and revisions of the paper downtime forms.
  • Ensure downtime kits containing paper charts and supplies are distributed and maintained in all clinical areas and departments.
  • Ensure a minimum of one week of supplies are available across the enterprise for all clinical departments.
  • Oversee annual downtime drills for the organization including inpatient units, office and procedural areas.
  • Ensure annual competency validation for all clinical and support team members including Physicians, Advanced Practice Providers, Pharmacists, Health Care Techs, Laboratory, Radiology, Cardiology, Emergency Department and procedural team members. All clinical support staff and ancillary departments such as dietary, transport, are to be included.
  • Partner with Clinical Education team.
  • Create and lead a Clinical Resilience and Preparedness governance committee.
  • Identify clinical lead champions from Nursing, Providers, Pharmacy and other clinical areas to participate in drills and support downtime operations.
  • Establish a downtime Command Center structure to be utilized during extended system outages.
  • Identify and establish plan for access to clinical staff schedules for providers, nurses and other key staff members. Lead annual failover testing with Epic's Publicly Accessible Gateway (PAG) and Isolated Recovery Environment (ICEBOX) in collaboration with team members from IT, Epic, Cyber, Clinical and Community Connect partners.
  • Oversee unit simulations and drills.
  • Partner with IT, Telecommunications, Marketing and Operational teams
  • Ensure a robust communication strategy and plan in the event of a clinical system downtime.
  • Applies strong knowledge of healthcare operations, proven communication, problem solving, critical thinking and management skills that promote patient safety and workflow efficiencies for the clinical team members, including our Community Connect partners, during a system downtime process.
  • Develop and manage recovery and data reentry procedures after clinical systems have been restored.
  • Serve as the leader for data reconciliation, EHR restoration and documentation recovery.
  • Collaborate with HIM and Revenue Cycle to determine prioritization and process for scanning paper documents and workflows to reconcile key documentation including notes, orders, medications, patient history, etc. as well as coding and billing.
  • Assumes responsibility for personnel related duties that include interviewing, disciplinary actions, payroll reporting, scheduling paid leave, and enforcing requires rules and regulations.
  • Monitors employee performance
  • Ensures timely communications for the purpose of goal setting, performance evaluations, wages increase and continued personal actions.
  • Direct various personnel functions including, but not limited to, hiring, performance appraisal, promotions, transfers and disciplinary issues.

Qualifications

Certifications:

  • N/A

Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree: Related Field or
  • Bachelor's Degree: Health Care Leadership or
  • Bachelor's Degree: Computer and Information Science

Work Experience:

  • Epic Downtime Planning, Recovery, & Readiness
  • Clinical Downtime System Preparedness
  • Developed & Led Enterprise Downtime Drills
  • Disaster Recovery Planning within a Health System
  • Related Healthcare - 5 years
  • Leadership - 3 years
  • Project Team Leadership

Skills & Knowledge

  • Demonstrated, relevant experience leading large and complex projects and servant leadership.
  • Demonstrated high customer service and service recovery skills.
  • Demonstrated exceptional communication and negotiation skills.
  • Demonstrated success working in a matrixed work environment.

Carle Health Company Overview

Find it here.

Discover the job, the career, the purpose you were meant for. At Carle Health, we're committed to fostering a workplace where every team member feels valued, respected and empowered, where passion and purpose come together to positively impact the lives of our patients and our communities. Find it all at Carle Health.

Our nearly 17,000 team members and providers work together to support patient care across central and southeastern Illinois. We’ve grown to include eight, award-winning hospitals and a multispecialty provider group with more than 1,500 doctors and advanced practice providers. We’re developing the next generation of providers and healthcare professionals through Carle Illinois College of Medicine, the world’s first engineering-based medical school, and Methodist College. Carle BroMenn Medical Center, Carle Foundation Hospital, Carle Health Methodist Hospital, Carle Health Proctor Hospital, Carle Health Pekin Hospital, and Carle Hoopeston Regional Health Center hold Magnet® designations, the nation’s highest honor for nursing care. We offer opportunities in several communities throughout central Illinois with potential for growth and life-long careers at Carle Health.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. Carle Health participates in E-Verify and may provide the Social Security Administration and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security with information from each new employee's Form I-9 to confirm work authorization. | For more information: .

Salary Range

The compensation range for this position is $68.85per hour - $118.42per hour. This represents a good faith minimum and maximum range for the role at the time of posting by Carle Health. The actual compensation offered a candidate will be dependent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, qualifications, location, training, licenses, shifts worked and compensation model. Carle Health offers a comprehensive benefits package for team members and providers. To learn more visit careers.carlehealth.org/benefits.

Avahi is seeking an accomplished AWS Cloud Architect to lead the design, implementation, and management of customer projects. This role is critical in driving successful migration, modernization, and DevOps initiatives. As the primary technical leader, you’ll guide customer consultations, create innovative proofs of concept (POCs), and shape our technical strategies. If you are passionate about AWS solutions and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, this role is perfect for you.

Account Manager – Hospitality & Corporate Accounts

Location: Asia – Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, or Dubai (Remote)

Company: Corporate Stays

Employment Type: Freelance – Full-Time | Remote
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET
Work Arrangement: Remote / Work From Home

About Corporate Stays

Corporate Stays is a leading provider of premium furnished apartments and corporate housing solutions across Canada and Latin America. We are passionate about delivering exceptional guest experiences while building long-term relationships with both individual travelers and corporate clients.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a motivated and commercially minded Account Manager to manage and grow relationships with corporate clients, existing customers, and recurring guests.

About the Role

As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing, retaining, and growing a portfolio of corporate accounts and existing customers while also identifying opportunities to generate new business.

You will serve as a key point of contact for assigned accounts, developing strong relationships, understanding client needs, and providing personalized accommodation solutions. The role combines account management, customer success, sales, retention, business development, upselling, and account growth.

The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, commercially driven, and comfortable managing multiple client relationships while identifying opportunities to increase bookings, revenue, and long-term account value.

Key Responsibilities

1. Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned corporate accounts, existing customers, and recurring guests.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients.
  • Understand client needs, travel patterns, accommodation requirements, preferences, and business priorities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by providing personalized accommodation solutions.
  • Maintain regular communication with key accounts through email, phone calls, and virtual meetings.
  • Conduct proactive follow-ups to monitor satisfaction, strengthen relationships, and identify new opportunities.
  • Address client concerns and coordinate internally to ensure issues are resolved promptly and professionally.

2. Account Growth, Retention & Reactivation

  • Develop strategies to increase retention, repeat bookings, and overall account value.
  • Proactively follow up with existing and dormant clients to generate additional bookings and reactivate inactive accounts.
  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities across the Corporate Stays portfolio.
  • Introduce additional properties, destinations, and accommodation solutions based on client needs.
  • Monitor account activity, booking patterns, and revenue potential to identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with high-value and strategic accounts.
  • Support renewals and ongoing client relationships to maximize long-term revenue.

3. New Business Prospecting & Acquisition

  • Research and identify potential corporate clients, companies, industries, and business opportunities within the assigned territory.
  • Prospect and initiate relationships with potential corporate clients.
  • Build and maintain an active sales pipeline.
  • Conduct outreach through email, phone, LinkedIn, virtual meetings, and other appropriate channels.
  • Qualify new business opportunities and understand the prospect's accommodation requirements.
  • Prepare customized accommodation proposals and solutions for prospective clients.
  • Follow up consistently with prospects throughout the sales cycle.
  • Support the acquisition of new corporate accounts and contribute to new business targets.
  • Collaborate with the Business Development and Sales teams when additional support or specialized expertise is required.

4. Sales & Revenue Growth

  • Identify opportunities to increase booking volume, revenue, and account value.
  • Prepare customized accommodation options, proposals, and commercial solutions based on client requirements.
  • Follow up on inquiries, proposals, and open opportunities until they are resolved or converted into bookings.
  • Support complex or high-value opportunities and coordinate internally to develop appropriate solutions.
  • Monitor sales opportunities and take proactive action to move them through the pipeline.
  • Meet assigned sales, revenue, retention, and account growth targets.

5. CRM & Account Management

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client, prospect, and account information in HubSpot CRM.
  • Document client communications, preferences, opportunities, follow-ups, and relevant account information.
  • Track account activity, bookings, revenue opportunities, pipeline progression, and customer engagement.
  • Ensure all opportunities and follow-up activities are properly recorded and updated in the CRM.
  • Use account data and historical activity to identify opportunities for growth, retention, and reactivation.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Reservations, Revenue Management, Guest Experience, Operations, and Business Development teams.
  • Ensure client requirements and preferences are clearly communicated to internal teams.
  • Coordinate internally to ensure seamless service delivery and timely resolution of client requests.
  • Collaborate with Business Development to ensure a smooth transition from newly acquired prospects into ongoing account management.
  • Share relevant client feedback and market insights with the appropriate teams.
  • Support the resolution of escalated client concerns when required.

7. Performance Tracking & Reporting

  • Meet or exceed assigned account management, retention, sales, revenue, and new-account acquisition targets.
  • Monitor individual account performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Track bookings, revenue, account activity, pipeline opportunities, retention, and reactivation efforts.
  • Provide regular updates and reports to the team leader regarding account performance, sales activity, opportunities, and challenges.

Title: Virtual Clinical Therapist

Reports to: Director of Telehealth

Department/Location: Remote

FLSA Status: Exempt

Requirements and Schedule:

  • Licensure: Must be independently licensed as a therapist in the state of Massachusetts. Highly preferred 3 years post independent licensure experience. Seeking experience in IOP/PHP settings.
  • Schedule: Monday-Friday 8a-4:30p EST, Monday-Friday 12p-8:30p EST

Role Summary:

Virtual Therapists are responsible for providing high-quality care and therapeutic services to individuals dealing with various behavioral issues. The therapist will use telehealth to facilitate 1:1 and group therapy, develop and implement treatment plans, conduct assessments, and work collaboratively with other healthcare professionals to deliver effective behavioral health interventions. Guidelight is committed to the professional growth and development of therapists and provides free clinical supervision hours to support clinicians.

Role Responsibilities/Competencies:

  • Conduct psychological and biopsychosocial assessments and evaluations to determine clients' needs. 
  • Develop and implement individualized treatment plans based on assessment findings. 
  • Provide evidence-based therapeutic interventions, including individual, group, and family therapy. 
  • Monitor and document clients' progress and adjust treatment plans to create a cohesive case conceptualization.
  • Collaborate with other healthcare professionals, including psychiatrists, social workers, and medical doctors, to provide comprehensive and continuity of care. 
  • Completes suicide risk assessment within identified time frames and with appropriate thoroughness and scoring while consulting with clinical leaders.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings and case reviews determining length of stay and level of care. 
  • Assess and identify community resources based on clients needs during treatment/ aftercare planning.
  • Adhere to all standardized Group Curriculum and Treatment Planning.
  • Educate clients and their families about mental health and behavioral issues while building supportive and trusting relationships 
  • Comes prepared to weekly clinical supervision with relevant client updates, case formulations, and questions to support high-quality care.
  • Adhere to all confidentiality and ethical guidelines as outlined by professional standards and laws. 
  • Stay updated on the latest research and developments in behavioral therapy and mental health. 
  • Identify with Guidelight Health’s Mission, Vision and Values

Required Qualifications

  • A master's degree in psychology, Counseling, Social Work, or a related field.
  • Valid MA independent licensure as a Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker (LICSW), Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC)

  • If eligible based on licensure status and applicable state regulations, must be willing to provide formal clinical supervision to associate-level clinicians as part of Guidelight’s supervision program. This includes actively supporting the development of associate licensed professionals in accordance with organizational standards and state-specific supervisory requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience providing behavioral therapy, counseling and group therapy.
  • Ability to manage clients effectively in virtual settings, including adapting interventions to a telehealth environment.
  • Comfort and competence with technology, including navigating HIPAA-compliant video platforms, EMRs, and virtual collaboration tools.
  • Strong engagement skills in a virtual space (ability to build rapport, maintain group cohesion, and intervene effectively when clients disengage).
  • Knowledge of or willingness to learn telehealth best practices, including crisis response and safety planning in a remote setting.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while staying closely connected to a distributed virtual team.
  • Commitment to creating a supportive and inclusive virtual group culture that mirrors the Guidelight client experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience facilitating group therapy in an IOP/PHP/RES/IP setting.
  • Experience working virtually
  • 3 years' experience post independent licensure
