raw.description:
Position Summary:

The Appeals & Grievances (A&G) unit manages Healthfirst member complaints, grievances and appeals that are presented by the member or provider pertaining to the authorization of or delivery of clinical and non-clinical services. A&G works in collaboration with divisions within and outside the organization to resolve issues in a timely and compliant manner.
The A&G Clinical Specialist is the subject matter expert responsible for all clinical case development and case resolution while ensuring compliance with Federal and/or State regulations. The incumbent will manage his/her own caseload and is accountable for investigating and resolving member or provider initiated cases. Manages all Department of Health (DOH) and executive complaints as needed. The incumbent may also handle clinical claim appeals that come from Healthfirst participating and non-participating providers.
This is either a remote or on-site position located at either the 100 Church Street location in New York City or the 1101 Greenwood Avenue location, Lake Mary, Florida. This position may require attendance at A&G/ Operations divisional meetings and Town Halls, some of which may require travel to one of the locations (T&E will be covered according to policy).

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for case development and resolution of clinical cases, such as: Pre-existing Conditions, Prior Approval, Medical Necessity, Pre-certification, Continued Stay, Reduction, Termination, and Suspension of services. The end to end process requires the Specialist to independently:
    • Research issues
    • Reference and understand HF’s internal health plans policies and procedures to frame decisions
    • Interpret regulations
    • Resolve cases and make critical decisions
    • Update file documentation such as the file notes and case summary
    • Manage all duties within regulatory timeframes
    • Communicate effectively to hand-off and pick-up work from colleagues
    • Work within a framework that measures productivity and quality for each Specialist against expectations
  • Prepare cases for Medical Director Review ensuring that all pertinent information (i.e. case summary, contract information, internal and external responses, diagnosis, and CPT codes and descriptions) has been obtained during investigation and is presented as part of the case
  • Prepare cases for Maximus Federal Services, Fair Hearing, and External Appeal through all levels of the appeal process
  • Additional duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

  • RN , LPN OR Dental Hygienist

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience in clinical practice with experience in appeals & grievances, claims processing, utilization review or utilization management/case management.
  • Demonstrated understanding of Utilization Review Guidelines (NYS ART 44 and 49 PHL), InterQual, Milliman or Medicare local coverage guidelines
  • Ability to work independently on several computer applications such as Microsoft Word and Excel, as well as corporate email and virtual filing system, (ie. Macess). Experience with care management systems, such as CCMS, TruCare and Hyland.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage large caseloads and effectively work in a fast-paced environment

raw.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

FUNDINGO is hiring a VP of Operations & Delivery to lead the execution of our client implementations and managed-services portfolio.

This is a hands-on player-coach role for an experienced Professional Services or implementation leader. You will oversee project health, capacity planning, delivery processes, team performance, and client escalations while remaining close enough to the work to step into at-risk engagements when needed.

As FUNDINGO takes on larger and more complex customers, this leader will bring greater structure, accountability, and predictability to delivery—building processes that support growth without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

ABOUT FUNDINGO

FUNDINGO is a Salesforce-native loan management platform helping lenders manage the complete lending lifecycle, including origination, servicing, accounting, borrower management, and workflow automation.

Our customers include non-bank lenders, private lenders, CDFIs, financial institutions, and organizations with complex lending operations. FUNDINGO serves as a mission-critical operating platform that powers how these organizations run their businesses.

Our implementations can be complex and highly configurable, requiring coordination across customers, project managers, implementation resources, product experts, engineering, QA, and third-party vendors.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Lead the portfolio of active implementations and managed-services engagements, maintaining visibility into milestones, risks, dependencies, commitments, and next steps.

  • Manage and coach project managers and implementation team members, setting clear expectations and holding owners accountable for delivery.

  • Own capacity planning and resource allocation across project managers, implementation resources, and shared specialists.

  • Establish and run delivery cadences, including portfolio reviews, project-health reviews, resource planning, and escalation management.

  • Identify delivery risks early and step into at-risk projects or client escalations when needed.

  • Standardize core delivery practices, including project planning, status reporting, action tracking, requirements handoffs, UAT, go-live, and post-launch transitions.

  • Partner with Solutions & Enablement to ensure each engagement receives the appropriate product expertise and solution guidance.

  • Collaborate with Sales on scoping, implementation feasibility, customer handoffs, and upcoming resource demand.

  • Work with Product, Engineering, and QA to address technical dependencies, release risks, and delivery blockers.

  • Strengthen scope and change-order management so timeline and commercial implications are addressed early.

  • Build the documentation, tools, processes, and performance metrics needed to make delivery more predictable and scalable.

  • Improve knowledge transfer so individual subject-matter experts do not become permanent bottlenecks.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Leadership has clear visibility into the health, ownership, risks, and next milestones of every client engagement.

  • Capacity needs and competing priorities are identified before the team becomes overloaded.

  • Projects follow a consistent delivery cadence with clear owners, dates, and follow-through.

  • At-risk engagements are addressed before they become major customer escalations.

  • Implementation timelines and milestone predictability improve.

  • Managed-services work is consistently prioritized, staffed, and tracked.

  • Cross-functional blockers are surfaced earlier and resolved more efficiently.

  • Delivery becomes increasingly repeatable and scalable while retaining the flexibility customers require.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Experience leading a Professional Services, implementation, or client-delivery function within a complex SaaS or enterprise software environment.

  • Direct responsibility for a portfolio of concurrent customer implementations.

  • Experience managing project managers, implementation consultants, or similar client-delivery professionals.

  • Strong capability in capacity planning, resource allocation, portfolio management, and prioritization.

  • Working knowledge of requirements gathering, implementation planning, scope management, UAT, go-live, and post-launch support.

  • Experience managing difficult client situations and coaching teams through delivery challenges.

  • The ability to create accountability without becoming the person personally responsible for carrying every project.

  • A track record of building practical operating processes that teams consistently use.

  • Comfort working as both a strategic leader and hands-on operator in an evolving environment.

  • Enough technical fluency to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, QA, and technical implementation teams.

  • Clear communication, strong client presence, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through.

  • Experience in lending, fintech, financial software, Salesforce, or other highly configurable enterprise platforms is valuable but not required.

WHAT WE OFFER

The opportunity

  • Be part of the legacy of a growing company at an inflection point, with the chance to make a real impact on our mission

  • Build and operate the delivery engine behind increasingly complex and enterprise-level customer engagements.

  • Take meaningful ownership rather than inheriting a narrowly defined corporate function.

  • Work directly with company leadership and have visibility into the broader business.

  • Build a function that can grow in scope and responsibility as FUNDINGO grows.

  • Help shape the operating model of a Salesforce-native lending technology company.

  • Work in a fully remote environment with a distributed team.

The package

  • Competitive compensation package based on experience and market

  • Full-time role with significant growth potential as FUNDINGO scales

  • 100% of employee medical and dental premiums covered

  • 401(k) with maximum match, vested as you go

  • 15 paid holidays per year

Compensation Range: $170K - $220K

raw.title: Customer Support Engineer
raw.excerpt: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
raw.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You keep business-critical processes running, and you make sure they keep running better.

Once a customer is running on blp, their processes are business critical. Invoices post or they do not. Orders flow or they sit. When something does not behave the way a customer expected, a document that did not post, an exception that should have resolved itself, a number that looks wrong, it comes to our Customer Support Engineering team. Critical incidents are always solved, for every customer. On our strategic accounts we go further: priority handling, tracked response times, and the extra mile on topics we would otherwise push back on.

As a Customer Support Engineer, you own incoming cases end to end. You investigate what the system did, what the data says and what the customer's process actually requires, and you fix it: you have the access and the authority to change configuration when that is the answer, and you know who to bring in when it is not. You are the person the customer hears back from, in writing, on a call, and increasingly in the room when something urgent needs solving now. You start on cases where the pattern is known and take on harder ones as your expertise builds.

As a Senior Customer Support Engineer, you take the hard technical problems on live systems: the cases where the cause is not obvious, where it crosses systems, data and process logic at once, where the same symptom has three possible explanations and only one of them is right. Everything difficult that comes out of the run phase lands with you. Two things sit alongside the case work, and they are what make this a senior job rather than a harder version of a junior one.

Stabilizing accounts. When an account's health goes bad, you go in and stabilize it. Not as a permanent assignment, but as a small, highly skilled squad that takes a customer whose numbers or whose confidence have slipped, works out what is actually wrong across the whole picture, fixes it, and hands back a customer who is running properly again.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own customer cases end to end: investigate, resolve, and confirm with the customer that it is actually fixed.

  • Diagnose across boundaries: platform behaviour, ERP behaviour, master data and process logic.

  • Decide what the real fix is, and make it: configuration, data, process, or a case for engineering.

  • Keep response times within our commitments, with priority handling on strategic accounts.

  • Recognize when a problem is bigger than one case, and hand it on with proper evidence.

  • Document what you learn so the next person does not have to learn it twice.

  • Support Consultants and Client Partners on the technical substance of customer escalations.

In addition, as a Senior Customer Support Engineer

  • Own the technically difficult cases from our live customer base to a verified root cause.

  • Go into accounts with a deteriorating health score, stabilize them and hand them back running properly.

  • Drive strategic initiatives that permanently reduce effort and improve the customer experience, from better diagnostics to customer-facing self-service and assistants.

  • Act as the counterpart to Product and Engineering, with evidence strong enough to change priorities, and push for structural problems to be solved once.

  • Build the diagnostic tooling, patterns and documentation that raise what the rest of the team can resolve alone.

  • Mentor interns and Customer Support Engineers, and raise the technical bar of the function.

What You Bring

For the Senior Customer Support Engineer level

  • Master's degree in a STEM field: computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, physics or similar.

  • 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role: application support at depth, technical consulting, solution engineering, integration engineering or equivalent.

  • Demonstrable debugging ability across systems, not only within one. APIs, data mapping, interfaces, logs.

  • Comfortable with data. SQL or equivalent, and the instinct to check rather than assume.

  • German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English.

  • Nice to have: ERP experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or similar, scripting in any language, or exposure to workflow automation and process mining.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

About Expedock

We are a tech-enabled workforce augmentation platform leveraging top 1% offshore talent & cutting edge technology to enable businesses to unlock their full potential

About the Client

Our client is a US-based logistics provider recognized for delivering reliable, efficient, and customer-focused supply chain solutions. With years of experience in domestic and international freight, they support shippers through smart processes, responsive communication, and modern operational tools. Their services cover a wide range of logistics needs, ensuring that every shipment is handled with accuracy, transparency, and care.

Schedule:Night Shift

Location:Fully Remote (WFH)

The Mission: Manage end-to-end ocean import shipments, ensuring compliance with global trade regulations while proactively identifying, managing, and resolving exceptions through close coordination with overseas agents, carriers, customs brokers, and internal teams.

What You'll Do:

  • Pre-Arrival Coordination & Arrival Notice Management
    • Receive pre-alert/shipment documents from origin offices or overseas agents.
    • Follow up with steamship lines for ISF confirmation, Arrival Notice, and freight invoices.
    • Review all charges (ocean freight, origin costs, documentation fees, amendments, etc.) and prepare accurate Arrival Notice billing.
    • Issue Arrival Notice + invoice to the consignee/brokerminimum 7 days prior to vessel arrival(or immediately for late vessels) to ensure timely payment and avoid delays.
  • Customs Clearance & Last Free Day (LFD) Management
    • Coordinate with customs broker for clearance status and resolve any holds (exam, AMS, PGA, etc.).
    • Track Last Free Day for both demurrage (storage) and detention (container use) daily.
    • Proactively send LFD alerts and reminders to consignee/broker starting 7 days before LFD, then 3 days, 2 days, and daily countdown once inside 48 hours.
    • Escalate to management when consignee is unresponsive or LFD is at risk.
  • Delivery Coordination & Trucking Arrangement
    • Arrange delivery with truckers once cargo is cleared and available (or on wheels if live unload).
    • Coordinate with consignee/broker on delivery appointments, special requirements (liftgate, inside delivery, etc.).
    • Handle any delivery exceptions (refused cargo, storage orders, redelivery fees) and ensure additional costs are approved and billed to consignee.
  • Container Return Monitoring & Detention/Per Diem Management
    • Monitor empty container return status daily after delivery.
    • Follow up with consignee/trucker for proof of empty return before detention clock expires.
    • Calculate and bill any detention/per diem charges incurred due to late return; ensure payment is collected from consignee (never absorbed by us unless pre-approved).
    • Dispute incorrect carrier detention invoices when applicable.
  • File Closure, Cost Reconciliation & Customer Communication
    • Reconcile final carrier and vendor invoices against quoted/billed amounts.
    • Issue any debit notes for additional charges (detention, demurrage, exam fees, waiting time, etc.) and follow up for payment.
    • Obtain proof of delivery, close file in system, upload all final documents, and release final invoice to customer.
    • Act as single point of contact for consignee throughout the shipment: provide proactive status updates, answer queries, resolve issues, and ensure complete customer satisfaction.

What You Need:

  • 2–4 years experienceinOcean Import Operations(FCL & LCL required)
  • Strong understanding ofUS import proceduresincluding ISF, AMS, PGA holds, customs clearance, demurrage, and detention
  • Hands-on coordination experience withsteamship lines, customs brokers, truckers, and overseas agents
  • Ability to track and manageLast Free Day (LFD)for both demurrage and detention
  • Experience handlingdelivery appointments, trucking arrangements, delivery exceptions, and cost approvals
  • Proficiency infreight forwarding systems/TMS
  • Amenable to working the night shift (US - EST time zone)
  • Comfortable with having their productivity monitored through tools like Insightful
  • Excellent communication skills and a strong customer service mindset
  • High attention to detail and ability to handle multiple files in a fast-paced environment

Technical Requirements

  • Fiber internet (PLDT Fiber, Converge, Globe Fiber, etc.) - recommended speed of 100/50 Mbps
  • Backup internet (mobile hotspot or secondary ISP) capable of at least 20 Mbps
  • Quiet, conducive home workspace
  • OPTIONAL: Wired Ethernet connection preferred during work hours
  • OPTIONAL: Power backup (UPS) if the location experiences frequent outages

Why Expedock

  • HMO coverage and leave creditsbecome availableafter three months of engagement.
  • Supportive Remote Environment: Work from home alongside acollaborative teamthat valuesgrowth and mutual success.
  • Structured Engagement & Training:Start strong with astructured engagement program and client-specific trainingdesigned to help you quickly master your assigned workflows.

Candidate Data & Privacy Notice

By submitting your application to Expedock, you acknowledge and consent to the collection, use, and processing of your personal information for recruitment and hiring purposes. Your information will be used to:

  • Evaluate your qualifications and suitability for current and future roles
  • Communicate with you throughout the recruitment process Improve our hiring processes and overall candidate experience
  • Maintain talent pools for future opportunities, where permitted by law

We handle candidate data with care and in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations. Your information will only be accessed by authorized team members and will not be shared with third parties without your consent, unless required by law.

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado and/or Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $125,000 – $145,000 / year

About RightMove Health

RightMove, powered by the Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS), is a fast-growing digital health startup delivering best-in-class musculoskeletal (MSK) care through a value-based, virtual model. Backed by the #1 orthopedic hospital in the world, RightMove combines world-class physical therapists, proven clinical expertise, and modern technology to improve outcomes and reduce unnecessary healthcare costs.

Role Overview

The Patient Engagement Specialist is a frontline role responsible for connecting eligible members and referred patients to RightMove’s virtual MSK care. This role serves as the first point of contact for patients and will support outreach, education, eligibility verification, and scheduling of initial clinical evaluations.

As an early-stage startup, we are looking for someone who is adaptable, patient-focused, and excited to help build and refine processes while delivering excellent patient experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct outbound phone outreach to eligible members and referred patients
  • Answer inbound calls and respond to patient questions about RightMove services
  • Educate patients on available care options and next steps
  • Verify eligibility and schedule initial evaluations
  • Accurately document all patient interactions in CRM systems
  • Escalate or route complex issues to appropriate internal teams
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, outreach effectiveness, and patient experience

Day-to-Day

  • Make outbound calls to introduce RightMove services
  • Support referred patients through onboarding and scheduling
  • Provide real-time patient support via inbound calls
  • Maintain accurate, compliant documentation
  • Operate in accordance with HIPAA and all applicable compliance requirements

Qualifications

Required:

  • High school diploma or GED (associate degree preferred)
  • 1–3 years of experience in healthcare customer service, patient engagement, scheduling, or call center environments
  • Strong verbal communication skills and comfort with phone-based outreach
  • Ability to explain healthcare services clearly and compassionately
  • Experience using CRM, scheduling, or documentation tools
  • Strong organization, attention to detail, and ability to multitask

Preferred:

  • Experience in telehealth, digital health, MSK care, or physical therapy
  • Familiarity with insurance eligibility and benefit navigation
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English) a plus

What Success Looks Like

  • Patients feel informed, supported, and confident in starting care
  • High conversion from outreach to scheduled evaluations
  • Accurate documentation and compliant workflows
  • Willingness to adapt, solve problems, and grow with a fast-moving startup
Salary: $50,000 – $60,000 / year

raw.excerpt: LANDR is a fast-growing audio company made up of left-brained creative technologists, right-brained music professionals and everyone in between.
raw.description:
LANDR is a fast-growing audio company made up of left-brained creative technologists, right-brained music professionals and everyone in between. Together, we are revolutionizing the process for music makers to help them create, master, distribute and promote their music.

We love music. We love musicians. Our mission is to give music makers the freedom to create and be heard. We bring our love of music to work every day and we are continuously innovating to create experiences that delight and engage our audience of over 6 million music creators.

We're looking for a Video Content Creator to make engaging content for LANDR's social media. You’ll film and edit, and also be one of the faces and voices of the content! We are looking for someone to bring a pop culture instinct, a working knowledge of music production, and the ability to explain things the way a friend would, not the way a brand would.

This is a 6-month contract, with the possibility of extension, focused on growing our reach with emerging artists and music creators. This position is remote and open to candidates regardless of location.

Before you apply: we ask all candidates to submit a short test video. You'll find the instructions at the bottom of this posting.

What you'll do

  • Create and feature on short-form vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram, YT Shorts, etc.
  • Create and feature on long-form video walkthroughs
  • Pitch video ideas rooted in what's happening in music and pop culture right now, including trends, sounds, releases, and conversations artists are having
  • Write or adapt your own scripts and hooks, keeping them tight, jargon-free, and native to each platform
  • Collaborate with our social, design, and video teams, on shoot planning and editing notes
  • Review performance with the Organic team at LANDR, and use what works to shape the next round of content
  • Stay on top of platform trends and formats, and bring new ideas to test

What we're looking for

  • On-camera experience as a creator, host, or presenter, with a portfolio or channel we can look at
  • A strong, natural presence on camera. You can hold attention in the first three seconds and keep it
  • A working knowledge of music production and the modern artist workflow (DAWs, mixing and mastering basics, releasing music independently)
  • A sharp ear for pop culture and a real feel for what's resonating with young music creators
  • Fluency in TikTok and Instagram Reels culture: hooks, pacing, trends, and what makes people stop scrolling
  • The ability to simplify technical ideas without dumbing them down
  • Excellent spoken and written English

How to apply: the test

  • Along with your application, please submit a short test video.
  • Deliverable: one 30–45 second vertical video, in English, in the style of "LANDR Can Do That?", a format built around one underused feature and the one artist problem it solves.
  • Pick something from landr.com you find interesting or useful (distribution royalty splits, free mastering, the plugin bundle, whatever) and explain it to the camera the way you'd tell a friend about a hack you just found, not the way a brand would pitch it. Hook in the first three seconds, one feature only, no jargon.
  • A phone camera is fine. Send it as a link (unlisted YouTube, Google Drive, whatever's easiest) or as file below.

At LANDR, we don’t just accept diversity, we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community. LANDR is striving every day to create a more diverse workplace, and we strongly encourage applications from people of color, women, LGBTQ people, people of any religion, age, or belonging to any marginalized community.

We accept people as they are and firmly believe diversity is essential to our success! If you’re applying to LANDR, it’s because you want to contribute to our amazing company and culture, and we’re thankful for that! We work hard to create the best experience for our employees and we’d love for you to be a part of it!

--

LANDR est une société audio à croissance rapide composée de créatif.ve.s, de technologues, de professionnel.le.s de la musique ainsi que de toutes les combinaisons possibles de ces domaines. Ensemble, nous révolutionnons le processus des créateur.trice.s de musique pour les aider à créer, maîtriser, distribuer et promouvoir leur musique.

Nous aimons la musique. Nous aimons les musiciens. Notre mission est de donner aux créateurs et aux créatrices de musique la liberté de créer et d'être entendus. Nous apportons chaque jour notre amour de la musique au bureau et nous innovons continuellement pour créer des expériences qui ravissent et engagent notre public de plus de 6 millions de créateurs de musique. Nous aimons les meilleures pratiques, mais nous n’avons pas peur de les briser.

Nous cherchons un·e créateur·trice de contenu vidéo pour produire du contenu captivant pour les réseaux sociaux de LANDR. Vous filmerez et monterez les vidéos, en plus d'être l'un des visages et l'une des voix de notre contenu! Nous cherchons une personne qui a la culture pop dans le sang, une bonne connaissance pratique de la production musicale et le talent d'expliquer les choses comme le ferait un·e ami·e, pas comme le ferait une marque.

Il s'agit d'un contrat de 6 mois, avec possibilité de prolongation, axé sur la croissance de notre portée auprès des artistes émergent·e·s et des créateur·trice·s de musique. Ce poste est en télétravail et ouvert aux candidat·e·s, peu importe leur lieu de résidence.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Créer et présenter des vidéos verticales courtes pour TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, etc.
  • Créer et présenter des vidéos explicatives longues
  • Proposer des idées de vidéos ancrées dans l'actualité musicale et la culture pop : tendances, sons, nouvelles sorties et conversations qui animent les artistes
  • Écrire ou adapter vos propres scripts et accroches en les gardant concis, sans jargon et adaptés à chaque plateforme
  • Collaborer avec nos équipes des réseaux sociaux, du design et de la vidéo pour la planification des tournages et les notes de montage
  • Analyser les performances avec l'équipe Marketing de LANDR et vous appuyer sur ce qui fonctionne pour orienter la prochaine série de contenus
  • Suivre de près les tendances et les formats des plateformes et proposer de nouvelles idées à tester

Ce que nous recherchons

  • Expérience devant la caméra comme créateur·trice, animateur·trice ou présentateur·trice, avec un portfolio ou une chaîne que nous pouvons consulter
  • Une présence forte et naturelle à l'écran. Vous savez capter l'attention dès les trois premières secondes et la garder
  • Une connaissance pratique de la production musicale et du flux de travail des artistes d'aujourd'hui (DAW, notions de base en mixage et en matriçage, sortie de musique en indépendant)
  • Une oreille aiguisée pour la culture pop et un vrai flair pour ce qui interpelle les jeunes créateur·trice·s de musique
  • Une parfaite maîtrise de la culture TikTok et Instagram Reels : accroches, rythme, tendances et ce qui fait qu'on arrête de défiler
  • La capacité de vulgariser des notions techniques sans les simplifier à l'excès
  • Une excellente maîtrise de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit (nécessaire puisque notre contenu s'adresse majoritairement à un public anglophone et que le poste implique de travailler avec une équipe internationale, notamment au Canada, au Royaume-Uni et dans le reste de l'Europe)

Comment postuler : le test

  • En plus de votre candidature, veuillez soumettre une courte vidéo test.
  • Livrable : une vidéo verticale de 30 à 45 secondes, en anglais, dans le style de « LANDR Can Do That? », un format construit autour d'une fonctionnalité méconnue et du problème précis qu'elle règle pour les artistes.
  • Choisissez un élément de landr.com que vous trouvez intéressant ou utile (le partage des redevances en distribution, le mastering gratuit, l'ensemble de plugins, peu importe) et expliquez-le à la caméra comme si vous parliez à un·e ami·e d'une astuce que vous venez de découvrir, et non comme une marque qui ferait son pitch. Une accroche dans les trois premières secondes, une seule fonctionnalité, aucun jargon.
  • Un téléphone suffit. Envoyez-la sous forme de lien (YouTube non répertorié, Google Drive, ce qui vous convient le mieux) ou sous forme de fichier ci-dessous.

Chez LANDR, non seulement nous acceptons la diversité, mais nous la célébrons, nous la soutenons, et nous prospérons dans l’intérêt de nos employé.e.s, de nos produits et de notre communauté. LANDR s'efforce chaque jour de créer un lieu de travail plus diversifié. Nous encourageons vivement les personnes de couleur, les femmes, les personnes LGBTQ, les personnes de toutes religions, de tous les âges et de toutes les communautés marginalisées à postuler.

Nous acceptons les gens tels qu'ils sont et croyons fermement que la diversité est essentielle à notre succès! Si vous postulez chez LANDR, c’est parce que vous souhaitez contribuer à notre succès et à notre culture extraordinaire, et nous en sommes reconnaissants! Nous travaillons fort pour créer la meilleure expérience pour nos employé.e.s et nous aimerions que vous y joignez!

raw.description:
Solutions Consultant

Who we are

Jellyvision is redefining how organizations experience benefits by bringing everything together in one modern, intelligent home. With ALEX Home, we combine our award-winning ALEX® decision support with a flexible benefits administration platform, giving employers and employees a simpler, smarter way to manage benefits year-round.

Our mission is to help organizations reduce complexity, lighten administrative burden, and drive real employee understanding and utilization without forcing rip-and-replace decisions. We meet teams where they are today and give them a clear path to what’s next.

The people behind Jellyvision are creative problem solvers who care deeply about getting it right. We debate ideas, give real feedback and sweat the details because those details are what turn complicated problems into great experiences for real humans.

We’re a human first company that trusts smart people to do great work. We value curiosity, kindness and willingness to try new things, learn fast and try again. You won’t just show up to do a job, you’ll help build what’s next, solve real problems and have some fun doing it.

What's the role?

As a Solution Consultant, you'll be a trusted advisor for the full ALEX Home suite and the Revenue and Renewal team's go-to product expert. You'll master our products, demo environment, system architecture, security and implementation requirements, customer needs and the sales process. You'll give consistent, high-quality solution support that speeds up deals and builds trust with buyers, brokers and partners. You'll also work with Marketing and Product to bring the voice of the market into our integrated benefits suite.

What you'll do to be successful

Sales execution and solution design

  • Partner with Account Executives on deal strategy for ALEX Home opportunities, and lead the solution side of complex and strategic deals
  • Model best-in-class discovery, demos and solution design for direct prospects, brokers and clients
  • Shape the proposed solution around each buyer's needs
  • Become a subject-matter expert in ALEX decision support, and help cross-train teammates
  • Answer solution information requests, design tailored solutions and deliver in-depth demos
  • Explain our integration capabilities, including APIs, file feeds and single sign-on (SSO), and how they fit each customer's architecture
  • Speak confidently to security and data-privacy topics in live conversations
  • Field questions and objections in real time, and show where our approach stands out against competitors
  • Partner with the Proposal & Deal Desk team, which owns RFPs, security questionnaires and plan analysis: provide expert input on RFPs and support plan design analysis to confirm product fit
  • Contribute to team revenue goals through win rate, deal velocity and solution quality

Training and enablement

  • Partner with Sales Enablement to create advanced solution collateral and roll out talk tracks for Benefits Administration and ALEX

Market insight

  • Partner with Marketing and Product to represent the voice of the market
  • Give input on sales strategy and solution planning for future products, working with SC leadership
  • Use your knowledge of customers' system and security landscapes to identify good fits for pilots and new products

Experience and skills you'll need

  • 5+ years in presales, solutions consulting, benefits consulting or implementation within benefits administration or HR technology
  • Experience designing and demoing complex enterprise solutions for C-level stakeholders
  • Experience with decision support or employee benefits engagement tools strongly preferred
  • Understanding of the broker and carrier ecosystem
  • Ability to absorb product and system details quickly and translate them for customers
  • Ability to create customer-facing collateral that addresses product and system concerns in plain language
  • History of collaborating closely across sales, marketing, legal, security and technology teams
  • Experience in a high-growth environment with new product launches
  • Strong communication skills: you present complex ideas in a way that's honest, compelling and empathetic
  • Up to 25% travel

The Details

  • Location: Remote
  • Salary Range: $125,000 - $145,000
  • Additional Compensation: Commission elgible

The compensation range listed for this role reflects what we expect to pay, but where someone lands within that range depends on a few things, like their skills, relevant experience, qualifications, and how the role fits within our overall compensation philosophy, including internal equity and the budget for the role.

This role is eligible for commission in addition to base salary. During the interview process, our team will share how the commission plan works, including target earnings and how performance is rewarded.

raw.description:
About the Role

Onward Search is growing, and we are looking to hire an exceptional Sales Director, Manufacturing & Engineering Staffing to join our team in a 100% remote capacity.

Onward Search is an award-winning recruitment and staffing agency with 19 years of experience connecting leading organizations across the country with exceptional talent. As we continue to expand our staffing capabilities within the Manufacturing & Engineering space, we are looking for an entrepreneurial, hands-on sales leader to help grow our client base, increase revenue, and support the continued growth of this vertical.

The Director of Business Development Managers will be responsible for managing and growing their own book of business while also leading a small team of Business Development Managers. This role is approximately 80% individual production and 20% or less of people management, making it ideal for someone who loves being in the weeds with clients, building new business, and closing deals while also coaching, mentoring and developing a high-performing sales team.

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in scaling a growing vertical within Onward Search while working with innovative organizations across the manufacturing, engineering, industrial, and related sectors.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Sales

  • Own and grow an individual book of business within the Manufacturing & Engineering staffing market.
  • Develop and execute a sales strategy to increase revenue and expand the client base.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities through market research, lead generation, networking, referrals, and other prospecting efforts.
  • Build relationships with key decision-makers and hiring leaders across manufacturing, engineering, industrial, and related organizations.
  • Develop a strong network of direct hiring manager relationships and continuously identify opportunities for account expansion.
  • Utilize our tools, AI, reporting system to research and identify a Focus 50 client list and target key clients and regions to prospect.
  • Understand client workforce challenges and provide strategic staffing solutions aligned with their hiring needs.
  • Negotiate and close new business while identifying opportunities to cross-sell Onward Search's additional services.
  • Consistently meet or exceed established sales, activity, revenue, and gross margin targets.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Manage, coach, and develop a small team of Business Development Managers.
  • Establish clear goals, KPIs, and performance expectations across the sales team and hold team accountable.
  • Provide ongoing coaching around prospecting, pipeline development, account strategy, negotiations, and closing.
  • Hold the team accountable to individual and overall business gross margin goals.
  • Foster a collaborative, entrepreneurial, performance-driven culture.
  • Partner with leadership to identify opportunities to grow the team as the Manufacturing & Engineering business scales

Client & Account Management

  • Serve as a strategic partner and primary point of contact for assigned client accounts.
  • Drive ongoing sales and account expansion activities across new and existing clients.
  • Partner with Client Services Managers, when assigned, to ensure strong client delivery while maintaining ownership of sales and account growth.
  • Participate in client intake calls to understand position requirements, hiring priorities, and expectations.
  • Manage client communication throughout the recruiting lifecycle, including candidate submissions, interviews, feedback, and offers.
  • Identify opportunities to increase job order volume and expand Onward Search's presence within existing accounts.
  • Maintain strong client relationships and consistently deliver an exceptional experience.
  • Recruiting & Delivery Partnership
  • Partner closely with recruiting teams to develop strong talent pipelines across specialized Manufacturing & Engineering positions.
  • Ensure recruiters have a clear understanding of client requirements, priorities, and expectations.
  • Evaluate and approve candidates for client submission when appropriate.
  • Monitor submittal, interview, placement, and start activity to ensure client needs are being met.
  • Leverage AI-enabled recruiting and sales workflows to improve sourcing, outreach, matching, pipeline management, and overall efficiency.
  • Partner with internal teams to identify strategies for hard-to-fill roles and priority skill sets.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain accurate job, client, candidate, and placement information within Bullhorn and other internal systems.
  • Manage job entry, client intake, candidate submissions, interview coordination, offers, locks, assignment updates, and other account responsibilities when a Client Services Manager is not assigned.
  • Partner with clients and internal teams to resolve timecard, assignment, or account-related issues as needed.
  • Complete required quality check calls and maintain strong ongoing relationships with clients and placed talent.
  • Consistently deliver at or above established KPI targets.
  • Use sales, market, and performance data to identify opportunities to improve revenue, delivery, and account penetration.
  • Consistently demonstrate Onward Search's core values both internally and externally.

How Success Is Measured

  • Success in this role will be measured through a combination of individual production, team performance, and overall growth of the Manufacturing & Engineering business, including:
  • New client acquisition
  • Client and portfolio expansion
  • Job order volume
  • CV/submittal goal attainment
  • Interviews and placements
  • Weekly gross margin growth
  • FTE growth
  • Cross-selling of Onward Search services
  • Sales pipeline growth and conversion
  • Strong MSP scorecard and/or NPS performance if applicable
  • Team achievement against established sales and KPI goals

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5+ years of business development and sales experience, preferably within the staffing industry.
  • Minimum of 1+ years of leadership or management experience, preferably within staffing.
  • Proven track record of building and growing a staffing book of business and consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong preference for experience within Manufacturing & Engineering, technical, industrial, higher skilled trades, or related staffing markets.
  • Established network of client and/or direct hiring manager relationships within relevant industries strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of the staffing and recruitment lifecycle, including contingent and contract staffing.
  • Experience managing and developing sales professionals in a KPI-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to secure new clients, expand existing relationships, and grow revenue.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to balance individual production with team leadership.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and growth-oriented environment.
  • Bachelor's degree required.

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to play a key role in growing and scaling Onward Search's Manufacturing & Engineering staffing business.
  • Highly visible role with the ability to directly influence revenue growth and the direction of the vertical.
  • Opportunity to maintain your own book of business while developing and leading a growing sales team.
  • Performance-driven environment with significant earning potential.
  • Collaborative and supportive culture built around entrepreneurial spirit, integrity, teamwork, and transparency.
  • 100% remote work environment.

Compensation

  • $100,000-$120,000, based on experience.
  • Commission eligible.
  • Comprehensive benefits and PTO package, including 401(k).

About Onward Group Holdings, LLC:

Onward Group Holdings, LLC is a platform of specialized talent and workforce solutions brands that connect leading organizations with expert talent across high-demand industries. The company combines deep domain expertise, proven infrastructure, and an expansive talent network to deliver solutions that go beyond traditional staffing.

With nearly 20 years in business, Onward Group Holdings partners with companies, schools, and organizations to help them build high-performing teams and thrive in the future of work. Its divisions include Onward Search (Marketing, Creative & Technology), Onward Accessibility (Digital Accessibility), Onward Education (K-12 Education), and Talera (Behavioral Health).

We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, and a 401(k) program for eligible full-time employees, along with resources designed to support well-being and career development.

We have built a culture fostered on entrepreneurial spirit, integrity, teamwork, and transparency. If you are energized by connecting people to opportunity, excited by emerging technologies, and motivated by measurable impact, you’ll fit in great with our team.

We’re committed to making every part of our hiring process accessible and inclusive. If there’s any adjustments we can make to support you as you apply and interview, please reach out to .

Applicants must be at least 18 years old to apply. 

Onward is an equal opportunity employer. We value a culture of inclusion and diversity within our workforce and are committed to maintaining a workplace free from prohibited employment conduct, including discrimination or harassment based on race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, civil partnership, status as a covered veteran, status in the Uniformed Services of the United States, citizenship and any other characteristic protected by State and Federal law. 

Salary: 100,000-120,000

raw.description:
Sobre Nosotros:

En Koltin, estamos rediseñando la forma en que cuidamos a nuestros papás, mamás, abuelos y abuelas, con el objetivo de ayudarles a mantenerse saludables, activos e independientes durante el mayor tiempo posible. Lo hacemos a través de nuestras membresías de salud, que integran:

  • Atención clínica enfocada en la prevención
  • Cobertura médica de gastos mayores
  • Programas de bienestar y comunidad

Somos la primera empresa en México que protege a personas adultas mayores, desde los 50 hasta los 84 años. Estamos creciendo rápidamente en todo el país, con un propósito claro: transformar la experiencia de salud para las Grandes Personas, haciéndola más humana, accesible y digna.

Sobre el puesto:

Como Guía Koltin, eres la primera persona de Koltin con la que habla un futuro miembro. Contactas a personas que ya mostraron interés, entiendes qué necesitan ellas y su familia, y las acompañas hasta elegir la membresía correcta y cerrar la venta: cobro y firma.

Para nosotros, una buena venta es una que el miembro entiende, usa y renueva. No buscamos a quien venda a toda costa, sino a quien asesora de verdad.

A quién buscamos:

Buscamos a alguien que no necesita que estén detrás de ella para dar resultados: que se toma su cartera como propia, cuida a cada persona con la que habla y siempre está buscando cómo hacerlo mejor.

  • Empática:Escucha antes de hablar y entiende lo que de verdad le preocupa a una persona y a su familia.
  • Organizada y estructurada: Tiene su agenda, su pipeline y sus pendientes bajo control; nada se le pasa.
  • Autónoma: Sabe qué tiene que hacer y lo hace, sin que nadie tenga que estar detrás. Siempre vas a tener acompañamiento, pero esperamos ownership.
  • Da seguimiento:Cierra los círculos que abre, con clientes y con su equipo.
  • Ambiciosa: Le gustan los retos y las metas, y siempre busca ir más allá de lo que se le pide.
  • Se adapta al cambio:En una empresa que crece rápido, los cambios le parecen oportunidades y no obstáculos.
  • Proactiva y de mejora continua: Ve lo que se puede hacer mejor y llega con propuestas a la mesa.

Lo que harás:

  • Contactar y dar seguimiento a tus leads por teléfono y WhatsApp, con disciplina en cada etapa del funnel.
  • Asesorar de forma consultiva: explicar la membresía con claridad y ayudar a elegir según necesidades, presupuesto y momento de vida.
  • Cerrar la venta (cobro y firma) y pasar al miembro al equipo de post-venta con toda la información en orden.
  • Registrar tu actividad en el CRM y cuidar la calidad de cada venta.
  • Compartir con tu equipo lo que funciona y proponer mejoras al proceso.

Requisitos:

  • Experiencia en ventas o atención a clientes.
  • Tener disponibilidad para trabajar de forma remota (para esta modalidad se excluyen los estados de CDMX, Edo. Mex, GDL y MTY)
  • Disponibilidad de tiempo completo e ingreso el primer lunes del mes de tu generación.
  • Uso de computadora, WhatsApp y herramientas digitales; experiencia con un CRM (HubSpot u otro) es un plus.

Beneficios:

🎓 Acceso a herramientas y beneficios para tu crecimiento profesional, como cursos, talleres, libros, etc
💊 Asistencia médica privada por videollamada (médico general, nutriólogo y psicólogo) ilimitado para ti y 3 familiares
🏈 Acceso a herramientas para tu cuidado físico (TotalPass)
🌴 9 días adicionales de personal leave por ley al año

👓 Seguro de Gastos Médicos Mayores

💻 Equipo necesario para hacer tu trabajo

💵 Apoyo mensual de $700 pesos adicionales al sueldo mensual
💎 Apoyo de $2,500 por ocasión única tras periodo de prueba

raw.description:
AI Technical Solutions Lead

12-month fixed-term contract | UK remote | Senior individual contributor | No direct reports

Quadmark designs and delivers technical training and enablement for some of the world’s leading technology and AI companies.

We’re looking for an AI Technical Solutions Lead to become a trusted technical authority for our AI work, helping us turn ambitious client ideas into technically credible solutions and ensuring the AI programmes we build and deliver are accurate, current and effective.

This is a hands-on role sitting at the intersection of AI, client consulting and technical enablement.

You might currently work in solutions engineering, applied AI, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering or technical pre-sales. Whatever your title, you’ll need to be comfortable moving between a conversation with a client’s technical stakeholders, briefing an internal team in straightforward language and getting hands-on with an API, prototype, lab or simulation to prove that something actually works.

What you'll be doing

Around half of your focus will be on new client opportunities. You’ll get underneath a brief to understand the real technical requirement, assess feasibility and risk, identify dependencies and translate your findings into a clear approach that our teams and specialist partners can deliver.

The other half will focus on technical quality and readiness across existing AI programmes. You’ll review content, labs, code examples and demonstrations, test technical exercises and equip our facilitators with the understanding they need to teach complex AI topics confidently.

You’ll also:

  • Act as a trusted AI technical advisor to our clients and internal teams.
  • Build and test lightweight prototypes, proofs of concept, labs, simulations and internal tools to validate ideas and reduce technical risk.
  • Work directly with AI models, APIs and developer tools to test whether proposed approaches work in practice.
  • Translate complex AI concepts and terminology into clear, actionable briefs for technical and non-technical teams.
  • Advise on the right AI tools and approaches for different client needs, including the trade-offs involved.
  • Identify where client expectations and technical reality diverge and navigate those conversations constructively.
  • Review technical content and demonstrations for accuracy before they reach learners.
  • Brief and support facilitators on complex AI concepts, demonstrations and likely client questions.
  • Keep pace with developments across AI models, developer tooling and implementation practices and turn them into practical recommendations.
  • Capture and share useful patterns so we don't solve the same technical problem twice.

What we're looking for

You'll need hands-on AI experience. We're looking for someone who has actually built, tested and troubleshot AI tools or applications, not someone whose experience is limited to talking about them.

You'll bring:

  • Hands-on experience building and testing AI tools, applications, labs, simulations, prototypes or API integrations.
  • Strong practical understanding of large language models and foundation models, including how they work, their limitations, context and data flows and multimodality.
  • Experience with common AI application patterns including RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering and fine-tuning.
  • Familiarity with agentic systems, tools and actions, workflows, orchestration and MCP.
  • Understanding of AI evaluation and safety, including evals, guardrails, moderation, human-in-the-loop approaches and observability.
  • Advisory, consulting, solutions engineering or similar experience helping others understand which AI tools or approaches to use and why.
  • Strong client-facing experience, including communicating confidently with senior and technical client stakeholders.
  • The ability to take complicated technical information and translate it into simple, precise language for different audiences and teams.
  • Strong problem decomposition: you can take a vague, high-stakes brief and create clarity without waiting for someone else to define the answer.

How you work

  • You'll thrive at Quadmark if you're proactive and take ownership. You'll follow an issue through rather than assuming someone else will pick it up and you'll care about the details because technical credibility matters.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and patient when helping other people understand complex ideas. At the same time, you're agile and able to move quickly in an environment where both priorities and AI technology can change fast.
  • You're precise about what technology can and can't do. You'd rather qualify a claim than oversell it, and you're comfortable constructively challenging an assumption when the evidence doesn't support it.
  • You'll also be someone who enjoys enabling other people to succeed. This role has no direct reports: your impact comes through your expertise, judgement, communication and ability to make the people around you more effective.

Bonus points

We'd particularly like to hear from you if you have:

  • A background in the technology industry.
  • Experience in solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineering, applied AI or technical pre-sales.
  • Experience in learning, enablement or consultancy.
  • Hands-on experience with current developer tools such as Codex, Claude Code or Cursor.
  • Experience working with major technology clients or partners.

The one thing

Make sure everything Quadmark scopes, builds and delivers in AI is technically sound, from the first client conversation to the last session delivered.

The practical details

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract and a remote-first UK role.

You must be eligible to work in the UK.

Quadmark offers flexible remote-first working, quarterly in-person team days, private medical insurance, travel insurance, EAP and mental health support, 25 days' UK annual leave and a three-day paid shutdown at the end of the year.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with hybrid-cloud storage replication.

raw.description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

Clio is at the forefront of the legal technology revolution that is transforming the legal experience for all. To ensure that law schools and the next generation of lawyers benefit from exposure to legal technology, and that Clio's academic footprint grows with a consistent, compelling voice in the market, we are hiring an Academic Enablement & Engagement Manager to lead content, curriculum, and cross-functional coordination for Clio's academic program.


Clio's academic access program focuses on establishing Clio as a trusted partner across every segment of the law school environment, including law clinics, law libraries, classrooms, and incubators. To ensure Clio succeeds in its academic program, this role wears two connected hats. First, it owns the development of AI and technology certification programs, curriculum, and enablement content that helps law schools and legal professionals build fluency in an AI-first era of legal practice, all with Clio's tools as the central enabling technology. Second, it serves as a consistent point of contact in Clio’s shared resource structure to ensure consistent and on-going engagement with law schools to champion Clio’s academic programs.


This is a remote role based in the United States.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and deploy AI and technology competency certification programs, curriculum modules, and turn-key instructional content that equip law students, faculty, and legal professionals to practice with Clio's legal technology tools, including live and on-demand enablement for faculty, librarians, and students.
  • Produce a dynamic, growth-oriented library of student-facing materials that build AI competency across the law school journey.
  • Help build and facilitate Clio's academic community programs to grow engagement and establish Clio as the preferred brand in legal education.
  • Act as the primary point of contact between the Academic team and Clio's central marketing, content, creative, communications, and events teams, ensuring consistent and ongoing academic messaging.
  • Create, manage, and coordinate a rolling, always-on engagement campaign leveraging multiple channels for the academic program, ensuring sustained visibility across the school year.
  • Coordinate planning and logistics for academic-focused conferences and on-site presence, partnering with the larger event team on bigger conferences.
  • Measure and optimize program performance by tracking enablement, engagement, completion, and preference data across all enablement initiatives, using insights to continuously improve impact.
  • Conduct ongoing research on the legal education market, tracking technology trends, competitor activity, and law school adoption patterns to inform strategy and content priorities.
  • Represent Clio in the legal academy profession through thought-leadership initiatives and speaking opportunities.
  • Act with a team-first mentality on shared initiatives, cross-promotional opportunities, and joint conference strategy where academic and bar audiences intersect.

What You Have

  • A JD, LLM, or similar law degree from a U.S. law school, or 2+ years of first-hand, non-student experience in a U.S. law school; OR 3+ years of experience in marketing, communications, content, or program/project coordination, ideally spanning multiple functions, ideally in higher education or the legal industry.
  • Demonstrated legal technology and AI competency, or strong aptitude for building it quickly.
  • Strong project management skills, with experience tracking multiple requests and deadlines across teams.
  • Excellent written communication skills, including experience with briefs, external messaging, instructional content, and product positioning.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with sales, partnerships, or business development teams.
  • Experience leveraging and experimenting with AI in the workplace to improve work throughput, individually and for the team.
  • Willingness to travel for conferences and events.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

  • Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance

  • Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin and Sydney) to be in office minimum twice per week.

  • Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.

  • EAP benefits for you and household members, including counseling and online resources

  • 401k matching and Child Education Savings

  • Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

​

The expected salary range for this role is $136,000 to $204,000 USD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

We're a Human and High Performing AI company, meaning we use artificial intelligence to improve all of our operations. In recruitment, AI helps us streamline the process for greater efficiency. However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.

Disclaimer: We only communicate with candidates through official @clio.com email addresses.

raw.description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $62,000 – $80,000 / year
