raw.excerpt: Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem.
raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Lead Engineer position will require both technical expertise and project management competency. This position will consist of site surveys, Bill of Material (BOM) review, engineering, installation, trouble shooting, test and turn up, and quality control checks. The Lead Engineer will work directly with site contacts, subcontractors, and internal team members to provide input on ISP designs and ensure successful network integration, trouble shooting and preventive maintenance activities. The position will support the deployment of Long-Haul Optical Transport Networks, LAN/WAN installations, testing, evaluation of equipment, implementation of network upgrades and system design changes. The position will ensure the uniformity of practices, quality control, and procedure implementation while being the primary contact for field engineering deployments at Lumen facilities.

The Main Responsibilities

Work closely with the program Field Engineering team to implement, protect and sustain operational network requirements. Provide estimates for Installation Ready Materials (IRM) and review of project BoM. Assist with development of project schedules. Provide functional guidance, supervision, training, and quality assurance as required for less qualified Field Engineers. Provide remote troubleshooting support during test & turn up phases of new installations as well as operational troubles. Perform site surveys to assist in development of Engineering Design Packages (EDP). Review and modify EDPs to ensure accuracy. Analyze and resolve onsite field installation discrepancies. Coordinate with installation subcontractors as required. Prepare and plan for future jobs as needed; review of proper tool set, IRM, and equipment list required to complete projects on schedule and within budget. Engage with the internal teams to facilitate new project implementation and network upgrades. Work closely with Field Operations Personnel (FOPS) to ensure the timely completion of projects. Respond in a timely manner to customer requests for information related to equipment maintained and monitored by Lumen. Other responsibilities deemed necessary by management.

Job Description

  • Responsible for the oversight of site implementation to include site surveys, cabinet installation, and any other associated tasks at sites in the network.
  • Address project/personnel issues as they occur and report to management in a timely manner.
  • Analyze drawings and other documentation to prepare SOWs.
  • Communicate with management, engineers, contractors and subcontractors on changes and adjustments to documentation.
  • Helps determine necessary resources for projects based on SOW content and scheduling.
  • Quality assurance and uniformity of installations / practices and procedures.
  • In field training and oversight for Field Engineers.
  • Singular point of contact for Site Managers regarding large site deployments.
  • Writing and updating field methods, procedures, and checklists.
  • Ensuring that current methods are followed in the field.
  • Deployment planning and coordination.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the Engineering Manager.
  • Multitask multiple projects at any given time.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Qualifications

  • Supporting the P9k program primarily in field engineering for at least 2 years.
  • Requires technical knowledge of Telecom ISP design and installation.
  • Experience using Optical Power Meter and test equipment.
  • In depth knowledge of AC/DC Power and Grounding is preferred.
  • Experience using amp and voltmeter.
  • Analyze and operate Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR).
  • Working knowledge of standard security operations and procedures.
  • Must have a current valid driver’s license.
  • Must have a current TS/SCI security clearance.

Must be willing to travel when needed up to 50%.

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

Location Based Pay Ranges

$103,711 - $138,281 in these states: AL, AR, AZ, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, ME, MO, MS, MT, ND, NE, NM, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, TN, UT, VT, WI, WV, and WY.
$108,896 - $145,195 in these states: CO, HI, MI, MN, NC, NH, NV, OR, and RI.
$114,082 - $152,109 in these states: AK, CA, CT, DC, DE, IL, MA, MD, NJ, NY, TX, VA, and WA.

Lumen offers a comprehensive package featuring a broad range of Health, Life, Voluntary Lifestyle benefits and other perks that enhance your physical, mental, emotional and financial wellbeing. Life at Lumen

Life at Lumen is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Our Lumen 8 behaviors guide how we interact, make decisions, and work together, shaping a culture built to perform and win.

To learn more about Life at Lumen and how we live the Lumen 8, please visit:

Background Screening

If you are selected for a position, there will be a background screen, which may include checks for criminal records and/or motor vehicle reports and/or drug screening, depending on the position requirements. For more information on these checks, please refer to the Post Offer section of our FAQ page. Job-related concerns identified during the background screening may disqualify you from the new position or your current role. Background results will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Equal Employment Opportunities

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all persons regardless of race, color, ancestry, citizenship, national origin, religion, veteran status, disability, genetic characteristic or information, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, family status, pregnancy, or other legally protected status (collectively, “protected statuses”). We do not tolerate unlawful discrimination in any employment decisions, including recruiting, hiring, compensation, promotion, benefits, discipline, termination, job assignments or training.

Privacy Notice

Lumen is committed to protecting the privacy and security of personal information collected during the recruitment and hiring process. All legitimate job openings will be posted on our official website or communicated through official company email addresses. If you encounter any job offers that request payment in exchange for employment at Lumen, they are not for employment with us, but may relate to another company with a similar name.

raw.title: Salesforce Technical Lead
raw.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLEFundingo is a loan servicing platform built natively on Salesforce.
raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Fundingo is a loan servicing platform built natively on Salesforce. Our customers are lenders and loan servicers who use Fundingo to run their day-to-day operations. Our delivery team works directly with those customers, building custom implementations, integrations, and data migrations that fit Fundingo to how each customer runs their business.

As a Salesforce Technical Lead, you'll set the technical direction for our delivery projects. You'll make the architecture decisions, own our Git-based development process and code standards, review the team's code, and direct the work of the Salesforce developers on each project. You'll also take part in internal strategy discussions and join sales conversations with prospective clients who need integration expertise.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, with development in Apex and Lightning Web Components as the primary focus. You’ll also lead technical design, review code, and guide developers on assigned delivery projects. The balance will vary based on project complexity and team needs.

You'll direct the developers' work on your projects, but this isn't a people-management role: developers don't report to you, and you won't handle things like time-off requests. It is also not an admin or configuration role.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Architecture and technical direction

  • Own the technical design for delivery projects, including automation, integration patterns, and how custom work extends Fundingo without fighting it. Document and communicate these designs so the team and the customer can understand them.
  • Choose the right tool for each requirement, whether that's Apex, Flow, Lightning Web Components, or configuration, and know when not to write code.
  • Weigh speed, scalability, and maintainability against each other, and communicate these considerations to the team.
  • Design integrations with outside systems like payment processors, accounting systems, and document providers that are reliable and easy to support.

Development process and code quality

  • Own the Git-based development workflow for delivery projects, including branching, pull requests, merge rules, and deployment practices, aligned with Fundingo’s company-wide engineering standards.
  • Use and enforce our company's coding standards, naming conventions, and design patterns, and make sure the implementation team follows them.
  • Review pull requests for correctness, security, performance, test quality, and fit with the design. Your feedback should help developers grow, not just get their code merged.

Team leadership and communication

  • Lead the developers' work on each project by assigning and sequencing tasks, pairing with them, unblocking them, and helping them improve their design and debugging skills.
  • Work with the Implementation Specialists and Business Analysts to break customer requirements into well-scoped work, and help project managers estimate, plan, and sequence it.
  • Raise the technical skill level of Fundingo’s developers and Salesforce admins through code reviews, pairing, best-practice guidance, and knowledge sharing.
  • Lead technical discovery and design sessions with customers. Turn business requirements into technical designs, and explain constraints, options, and tradeoffs in plain language.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for customers' IT teams and outside vendors on integrations, data migrations, and escalations.
  • Support sales and leadership by joining conversations with prospective clients about integrations and complex requirements, and by bringing a technical perspective to internal strategy discussions.

Hands-on development and delivery

  • Build scalable and performant implementations using Apex, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce tools.
  • Plan and oversee data migrations from legacy systems, including mapping, transformation, validation, and cutover.
  • Lead troubleshooting of production issues in customer orgs using debug logs and customer reports.
  • Support technical go-live readiness, including deployment plans, release coordination, and post-launch documentation.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required

  • 5 or more years of hands-on Salesforce development with Apex, SOQL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • 2 or more years leading the technical work of other developers on a project team, including assigning and reviewing their work and guiding design decisions.
  • Experience leading the technical side of customer-facing Salesforce projects, from discovery and design through go-live.
  • A track record of making and defending architecture decisions on Salesforce projects using established patterns, such as trigger frameworks and service, selector, and domain layers.
  • Strong command of Salesforce DX, source-tracked development, and sandbox strategy.
  • Expert knowledge of Git, plus experience setting up and enforcing a branching and pull request workflow for one or more development teams.
  • Extensive code review experience and a clear, well-reasoned point of view on code quality, standards, and testing.
  • Mastery of governor limits, bulkification, and performance tuning.
  • Excellent communication skills. You speak clearly and confidently with engineers, project managers, executives, prospective clients, and non-technical business users.
  • Experience mentoring developers and raising the skill level of a team.

Strongly preferred

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification.
  • REST API integration experience between Salesforce and financial services systems.
  • Experience with large data migrations into Salesforce, using tools like Data Loader, ETL platforms, or custom scripts.
  • Background in lending, loan servicing, financial services, or another regulated industry.
  • Consulting or professional services experience, including working within scopes, estimates, and project budgets.
  • Experience supporting sales or pre-sales conversations as the technical expert.
  • Familiarity with AI coding tools like Claude Code in day-to-day development, and a practical view on using them responsibly alongside coding standards and code review.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with Experience Cloud, Flows, and Platform Events.
  • Active in the Salesforce developer community. Trailhead, Stack Exchange, blog posts, speaking, or open source contributions all count.

WHAT WE OFFER

The opportunity

  • Be part of the legacy of a growing company at an inflection point, with the chance to make a real impact on our mission
  • Build and operate the delivery engine behind increasingly complex and enterprise-level customer engagements.
  • Take meaningful ownership rather than inheriting a narrowly defined corporate function.
  • Work directly with company leadership and have visibility into the broader business.
  • Build a function that can grow in scope and responsibility as FUNDINGO grows.
  • Help shape the operating model of a Salesforce-native lending technology company.
  • Work in a fully remote environment with a distributed team.

The package

  • Competitive compensation package based on experience and market
  • 100% of employee medical and dental premiums covered
  • 401(k) with maximum match, vested as you go

● 15 paid holidays per year

Compensation Range: $130K - $160K

raw.excerpt: Position DescriptionThe Client Success Executive serves as the strategic relationship owner for assigned health plan, employer, third-party administrator (TPA), broker/consultant, and other strategic clients.
raw.description:
Position Description

The Client Success Executive serves as the strategic relationship owner for assigned health plan, employer, third-party administrator (TPA), broker/consultant, and other strategic clients. This role is accountable for client health, executive relationships, retention, growth, utilization, and value realization.

The CSE develops a deep understanding of each client’s business objectives, benefit strategy, population needs, performance expectations, and evolving priorities. The role translates MDLIVE performance and capabilities into a clear value story and leads account strategies that strengthen the partnership, protect revenue, increase adoption, and create sustainable growth.

The CSE leads strategic direction and executive engagement while partnering closely with Account Management on day-to-day execution, issue management, and client coordination. Success requires strong executive presence, commercial judgment, healthcare expertise, and the ability to align cross-functional teams around complex client priorities.

Essential Job Functions

  • Serve as the primary strategic relationship owner and trusted advisor for assigned clients.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans focused on client health, executive alignment, retention, utilization, growth, and long-term partnership objectives.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior and executive client stakeholders; identify decision-makers, influencers, and opportunities to strengthen MDLIVE’s position.
  • Develop a deep understanding of client business objectives, benefit strategy, population health priorities, member engagement needs, and measures of success.
  • Own the overall client health narrative and proactively identify relationship, performance, financial, contractual, utilization, and renewal risks.
  • Lead renewal and revenue-retention strategy in partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal, Account Management, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Identify and advance expansion opportunities through additional MDLIVE solutions, increased adoption, and improved utilization.
  • Translate operational, clinical, financial, utilization, and engagement data into executive-level insights and recommendations.
  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews, Annual Strategic Reviews, executive meetings, and multi-year partnership planning.
  • Lead strategic and executive escalations, coordinating internal alignment, resolution strategy, and client communication.
  • Serve as the voice of the client internally and act as the cross-functional quarterback for client strategy and commitments.
  • Partner with Account Management to align strategic priorities with tactical execution while maintaining clear ownership of day-to-day operations and issue follow-through.
  • Maintain accurate visibility into client health, retention risk, growth opportunities, executive relationships, and key commitments in applicable client management systems.
  • Monitor healthcare, virtual care, benefit, and competitive trends relevant to assigned clients.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

As a member of the Cloud Success Readiness team, you will be deeply invested in every aspect of the Industries Cloud customer experience. You will work closely with Technology & Product (T&P) and our Customer Success Group (CSG) teams to ensure that we are delivering customer success to every customer at scale.

  • Cloud Success Readiness improves customer Adoption and Product Quality by proactively addressing the most relevant customer needs, and by readying our stakeholders to deliver product innovation to our customers.
  • As a Readiness Architect, you will be responsible for understanding the Industries Cloud product portfolio, maintaining deep knowledge of product capabilities, and how they map to key customer use cases.
  • You will leverage your product knowledge and technical expertise to surface product insights and recommendations, and document Product Feedback for the T&P organization. You’ll work closely with Cloud Success teams, including Success Architects, Success Guides, Support Engineers, and Account Success stakeholders to scale your product expertise and knowledge of the product lifecycle to better enable their work with customers.
  • You will manage your work via Strategic Initiatives across the product lifecycle including new products and features, end-of-life retirements, and strategic programs such as migration or adoption efforts.
  • You will act as early adopters to bring architectural guidance, product expertise, innovation, and knowledge capital to our stakeholders in Customer Success and Technology & Products.
  • The ideal candidate will be comfortable collaborating within a larger team of subject matter experts and developing key stakeholder relationships across the organization to influence decision making.

Key Responsibilities

Product Lifecycle & Subject Matter Expertise

  • Maintain a deep technical, functional, and domain understanding of the Industries Cloud product portfolio, roadmap, and all in-market and new products.
  • Act as an early adopter, developing expertise for all new product introductions, feature releases, large-scale migrations, or product retirements.
  • Practice continuous learning through first-hand product experimentation and participation in Product-driven betas and pilots.

Strategic Alignment & Product Feedback

  • Establish and own relationships with Product Management Leaders and key subject matter experts, strengthening the strategic partnership with T&P.
  • Engage T&P and CSG stakeholders in the development of product feedback and roadmaps.
  • Identify, document, and track recommended product enhancements based on customer, partner, and internal stakeholder input.
  • Develop product requirements and deliver them to Product Leadership for roadmap consideration.

Stakeholder Enablement & Readiness

  • Document best practices and learnings from product interactions (like pilots and pre-launch discovery) to deliver readiness for scale.
  • Deliver this knowledge capital and architectural guidance to Cloud Success teams, including Success Architects, Success Guides, Support Engineers, and Account Success stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with your Cloud Success team to create a holistic strategic approach that supports the overall product strategy and customer success.

Customer Adoption Strategy

  • Provide product expertise to support the creation and rollout of strategies aimed at improving the product adoption score.
  • Actively participate in efforts to improve overall customer health for the product.

Continuous Improvement

  • Work with other Readiness Success Architects across Cloud Success to share best practices and continuously improve the team's operating model

Skills & Expertise

  • Executive Communication: Strong oral and written communication skills. Proven record of presenting to and updating internal and external stakeholders, including executive personas.
  • Prioritization Agility: Approach work with a ‘beginner’s mind’ and shift focus and direction when needed to drive higher priority outcomes.
  • Drive for Results: Can be counted on to exceed goals successfully; is constantly and consistently one of the top performers; very bottom-line oriented; steadfastly pushes self and others for results.
  • Critical & Strategic Thinking: Ability to confidently synthesize a broad array of information, identify themes, and develop tactical plans to drive meaningful business changes with executives.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Can apply domain and product knowledge to influence product leaders priorities and design decisions. Build relationships as trusted partner with Technology & Product organization.
  • Content & Training Development: Creating, managing, and distributing relevant training materials that is visually clear to meet needs of varying audiences of business and technical aptitude.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Acting as a liaison between departments such as product and engineering, and customer success roles like Guides, Support and Architects to ensure content is accurate, and impactful.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 9+ years experience in Customer Success or Product Management individual contributor role in the SaaS industry.
  • Hands-on experience working with Salesforce products, including deep understanding of current product suite and product capabilities that meet common customer use cases; understanding of competitor products and landscape a plus.
  • Track record of collaborating within a team of subject matter experts who deliver against strategic business initiatives.
  • Has held positions requiring interaction with both technical and non-technical stakeholders across different functions. Understands and can translate customer use cases to technical and functional requirements.
  • Has developed enablement materials and delivered training to functional and technical audiences
  • Enablement, consulting or Salesforce product experience a plus.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

raw.description:
We are looking for an experienced pharmacovigilance medical writer to join our growing medical writing team.

What We're Looking For: A highly motivated and detail-oriented medical writer who combines strong regulatory writing expertise with a client-focused mindset and a passion for developing others. You will play a key role in delivering high-quality regulatory documents, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the growth of the wider team. The Medical Writer will be responsible for medical writing including:

Key Responsibilities:

  • Author, review, and quality check a range of regulatory and pharmacovigilance documents, including:
    • PSURs/PBRERs
    • PADERs
    • ACOs
    • DSURs
    • Risk Management Plans (RMPs)
  • Ensure documents are scientifically accurate, regulatory compliant, and delivered within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyse, interpret, and present safety data effectively.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for clients, supporting project delivery and fostering strong working relationships.
  • Provide guidance, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to junior medical writers to support their professional growth and development.
  • Contribute to process improvements and the continuous enhancement of medical writing quality standards.
  • MD, pharmacy or Life Science degree (Masters or PhD is desirable)
  • Minimum 2 years' experience in Medical Writing and associated fields (case processing, signal detection or risk management) ideally within a CRO environment
  • Ability to manage multiple and varied tasks and prioritize workload with attention to detail
  • Ability to effectively train and mentor Associate Medical Writers
  • Must be a strong team player
  • Fluency in English, an additional language is a benefit

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.

We are a global pharmacovigilance specialist. Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.

That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.

raw.description:
VIDIZMO is an AI software company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia. We build Nexus, AI Intelligence Hub, AI Live Insight and Redactor, a product family that lets an organization search, analyze, redact and act on its unstructured data, where video, audio, images, documents and text are treated as equal first-class sources rather than one format with the rest bolted on. More than 100 customers run VIDIZMO in production across public safety and justice, government, healthcare, financial services, education, legal, manufacturing and energy, and much of that installed base runs on premises, in air-gapped environments, or in FedRAMP High environments through our hosting partners, on a CJIS Security Policy-aligned architecture.

We are an independent software vendor. We build and support the software, and the channel sells it, with qualified partners also installing, delivering and supporting deployments for their own clients. That model shapes almost every role here: the people we hire spend their time making partners and customers successful rather than pushing paper through a direct sales funnel.

As we continue to expand our footprint across public sector and enterprise markets, we are building a world-class channel organization to accelerate growth through strategic partners, resellers, and system integrators.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Channel AM to design, build, and scale our partner-driven sales engine. This role is responsible for recruiting and managing a network of resellers, system integrators, and technology partners, and for driving measurable revenue growth through those relationships — with a particular focus on public sector and public safety markets.

The ideal candidate has a proven, quantifiable track record in IT/enterprise software sales — SaaS experience strongly preferred — and understands how to navigate long government sales cycles, procurement processes, and partner-led go-to-market strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Partner Recruitment & Onboarding

  • Identify, evaluate, and recruit new channel partners including resellers, system integrators (SIs), and technology alliance partners
  • Design and execute structured onboarding programs to enable partners to sell VIDIZMO's platform effectively
  • Build a scalable partner tiering and certification framework

Revenue Growth & Pipeline Management

  • Own and drive channel-sourced revenue targets on a quarterly and annual basis
  • Build joint pipeline with partners and actively manage deal registration, forecasting, and progression
  • Support partners through complex, multi-stakeholder public sector sales cycles

Go-to-Market Strategy

  • Develop joint go-to-market plans, campaigns, and enablement content with key partners
  • Collaborate with marketing to build co-branded materials, case studies, and public sector-specific positioning (e.g., public safety, law enforcement, justice, transportation)
  • Identify white-space opportunities within existing partner accounts

Partner Management & Enablement

  • Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) with partners to track performance against targets
  • Provide technical and sales enablement training to ensure partners can articulate VIDIZMO's value proposition confidently
  • Act as the primary escalation point for partner-related issues, ensuring high satisfaction and retention

Commercial & Contractual Ownership

  • Negotiate partner agreements, margin structures, and deal registration terms
  • Ensure compliance with internal pricing, discounting, and legal guidelines
  • Maintain accurate records of partner agreements, performance data, and pipeline in CRM

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with direct sales, product, and customer success teams to ensure a seamless partner-assisted sales motion
  • Provide market feedback to product and leadership on public sector and public safety buyer needs

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, IT, or a related field (MBA preferred)
  • 5+ years of experience in IT/enterprise software sales, channel sales, or partnership management
  • Demonstrated, quantifiable track record of quota attainment (e.g., % of quota achieved, average deal size, peer ranking within sales team)
  • Prior experience selling into the public sector required; experience in public safety (law enforcement, emergency management, justice/courts, homeland security) strongly preferred
  • Experience selling SaaS or cloud-based enterprise software strongly preferred
  • Proven experience building and scaling a channel/partner ecosystem from the ground up or significantly growing an existing one
  • Strong understanding of government procurement processes, RFPs, and public sector buying cycles
  • Excellent negotiation, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills
  • Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) for pipeline and partner management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Existing relationships with resellers or system integrators serving public safety or government agencies
  • Experience with AI, video intelligence, data analytics, or related enterprise software categories
  • Familiarity with FedRAMP, StateRAMP, or other public sector compliance/procurement frameworks
  • Experience managing partner programs across multiple U.S. states or international markets

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary with uncapped, performance-based commission structure
  • Opportunity to build and shape a channel program from an early stage
  • Work with a Microsoft Solutions Partner at the forefront of AI innovation
  • High-ownership culture with direct access to leadership
  • Exposure to cutting-edge AI/LLM-powered enterprise products

VIDIZMO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Company Overview:

Asymchem Inc., is part of Asymchem Laboratories Co., founded in 1999 as a global integrated Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) providing drug R&D and manufacturing for leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies. Our mission is to drive smarter, greener, and more cost-effective manufacturing to support clinical research and commercialization. Asymchem currently operates eight manufacturing facilities offering solutions ranging from early clinical stage to commercial stage, including R&D, cGMP production of advanced intermediates, APIs, formulations, and clinical research services. Asymchem Group, headquartered in Tianjin, P. R. China. is a publicly traded company on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (stock code 002821.SZ)

Job Overview:

The Senior Director of Business Development leads commercial growth across small molecule, large molecule, peptide, oligonucleotide, and multimodal CDMO services. This role is responsible for identifying high‑value opportunities, building strong relationships with biotech and pharma clients, and securing complex development and manufacturing programs that support Asymchem’s revenue goals. The Senior Director partners closely with internal technical and operational teams to shape client solutions, manage the full BD cycle from prospecting through closing, and strengthen Asymchem’s presence across key territories.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities to expand the company's reach and impact
  • Foster long-term relationships with clients using existing networks and other sales tools to grow the client base
  • Maintain close contact with key decision-makers at customer organizations across different departments
  • Lead project acquisition - negotiate contracts, generate client proposals and bids, and close deals to meet business objectives
  • Collaborate with colleagues from various areas to develop tailored solutions and encourage internal cross-departmental cooperation
  • Attend and participate in key conferences to enhance company visibility and identify new opportunities / Travel 50%

Experience Requirements - Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities (KSAs):

  • Minimum BSc in a Life Sciences discipline; MSc or PhD preferred
  • 8–12 years technical experience in pharmaceutical/biotech or CDMO environments and/or 8–10 years proven business development experience
  • Proven experience selling including;
  • small molecule,
  • large molecule/biologic,
  • peptide & or oligonucleotide multimodal CDMO services, with the ability to position differentiated capabilities across modalities.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive complex, multi‑modality partnership structures and expand strategic accounts across diverse therapeutic platforms.
  • Demonstrated record of success in business development including large and complex partnership and/or licensing transactions
  • Demonstrable understanding of the drug discovery and development process
  • Strong understanding of the drug discovery and development process, including IND, clinical phases, and NDA pathways
  • Experience leading or mentoring junior BD team members; prior people‑management experience preferred

Travel Requirements

  • This position requires travel up to 50 percent to support customer engagement, attend key industry conferences and maintain strong visibility across assigned territories. Travel will include both domestic and occasional international trips as needed to advance commercial objectives.

Benefits:

  • Day 1 Coverage for Medical, Vision (Co. Paid), and Dental Insurance
  • Co. Paid ~Life Insurance; Short-Term Disability (STD) & Long-Term Disability (LTD)
  • Paid ~Holidays, Vacation, Sick Time, and Maternity Leave
  • Matching 401K

raw.description:
Director Engineering & Project Delivery

Location: Remote, with travel to headquarters in Ormond Beach, FL, and customer sites
Reports To: Chief Strategy & Services Officer
Employment Type: Full-time
Travel: Up to 40%, domestic and international
Schedule: Five days per week; occasional extended hours, weekends, and off-hours customer support required

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Director of GMP Engineering & Project Delivery to build and lead an integrated delivery function supporting customers in regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and life sciences environments.

This leader will establish the strategy, standards, staffing model, and commercial approach that connect design, procurement, fabrication, installation, qualification, validation, and turnover into a coordinated offering. The role partners closely with established Commissioning, Qualification & Validation (CQV), Field Service, and Certification teams while those groups retain responsibility for their respective operations.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in GMP facilities, equipment, and computerized systems with experience building technical organizations, managing third-party engineering partners, and delivering projects against quality, schedule, and financial commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery Strategy & Team Development

  • Build the GMP delivery function, including service offerings, operating structure, staffing plans, billing rates, utilization targets, and phased hiring criteria.
  • Establish a repeatable delivery approach that connects engineering, manufacturing, installation, qualification, and turnover.
  • Align standards, resources, and customer commitments across CQV, Field Service, Certification, and other internal teams.
  • Determine which capabilities to maintain internally and which to support through qualified partners.
  • Partner with functional leaders to recruit, develop, and mentor multidisciplinary technical talent.
  • Create competency frameworks and career development paths to support long-term team growth.

Engineering, Qualification & Validation

  • Serve as the technical authority for GMP facility and equipment design, including user requirements, basis of design, design rationale, and formal design reviews.
  • Establish engineering and validation standards, document templates, and review procedures.
  • Develop risk-based approaches to computer system validation (CSV) and computer software assurance (CSA) in coordination with CQV.
  • Provide oversight of data integrity, electronic records and signatures, audit trails, and validated computerized systems.
  • Resolve complex technical issues involving cleanroom classification, containment, air handling, utilities, material and personnel flow, and contamination control.
  • Support the expansion of certification services, including biological safety cabinets, HEPA filtration, cleanroom classification, vaporized hydrogen peroxide biodecontamination, and requalification.
  • Ensure work meets applicable cGMP requirements and relevant standards, including FDA regulations, EU GMP Annexes 1 and 11, ISO 14644, NSF/ANSI 49, GAMP 5, and ISPE guidance.

Vendor & Project Oversight

  • Select, qualify, and technically manage vendors supporting automation, controls, and process engineering.
  • Define vendor scope, evaluate proposals, review technical specifications, and approve deliverables.
  • Review vendor designs, software and control specifications, protocols, and turnover packages for alignment with project qualification requirements.
  • Maintain approved vendor and supplier qualification programs in partnership with Quality.
  • Establish project controls for schedules, costs, earned value, risks, and change management.
  • Manage change orders for internally delivered work, including scope identification, pricing, and customer discussions.
  • Coordinate procurement, expediting, installation supervision, and transition to qualification with existing corporate functions.

Financial & Customer Leadership

  • Own financial performance for the function, including revenue, billable utilization, realized billing rates, gross margin, and EBITDA contribution.
  • Support sales and proposals with technical scope, pricing, resource plans, and customer presentations.
  • Serve as a senior technical contact for customers, explaining engineering decisions, validation approaches, corrective actions, and recommendations.
  • Partner with Quality, Legal, and Risk to support appropriate quality systems and professional liability coverage for engineering, qualification, and validation services.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, chemical, biomedical, industrial engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 12 years of progressive experience delivering GMP facilities, equipment, or processes within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, advanced therapy medicinal products (ATMP), medical device, or high-containment life sciences environments.
  • At least five years leading multidisciplinary technical teams, including hiring and developing engineers and qualification personnel.
  • Deep understanding of the CQV lifecycle, including commissioning strategy, IQ/OQ/PQ, and requalification.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering CSV or CSA for GxP computerized systems.
  • Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, ALCOA+ principles, and data integrity expectations.
  • Experience with cleanrooms, isolators, restricted access barrier systems, biological safety cabinets, or other controlled and containment environments.
  • Experience managing third-party automation, controls, or process engineering vendors on capital projects.
  • Proven ability to establish technical processes, standards, staffing models, and delivery capabilities.
  • Prior profit-and-loss or cost-center ownership, including responsibility for budgets, utilization, and margins.
  • Strong customer communication, commercial judgment, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and familiarity with project controls and validation lifecycle management platforms.
  • Valid driver’s license, acceptable driving record, valid passport, and ability to meet travel requirements.
  • Successful completion of a background check and drug screening.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced technical degree or MBA.
  • Experience building an engineering, delivery, or validation function within an established manufacturer.
  • Field certification experience involving NSF/ANSI 49, HEPA filters, biological safety cabinets, or cleanroom classification.
  • Familiarity with certification and accreditation requirements.
  • Experience delivering modular, mobile, or prefabricated GMP facilities.
  • Experience in ATMP, cell and gene therapy, aseptic fill-finish, or hospital pharmacy compounding under USP 797/800.
  • International project experience, particularly in the Middle East or Asia-Pacific.
  • Relevant professional credentials, such as PE, PMP, CQE, CSQE, or ISPE/PDA certifications.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

  • Perform site inspections requiring standing, walking, kneeling, bending, reaching, and climbing ladders or stairs.
  • Work at active construction sites, in mechanical rooms, and occasionally in confined or elevated spaces.
  • Work in varying temperatures and noise levels.
  • Wear required cleanroom garments and personal protective equipment.
  • Lift and carry up to 25 pounds, with assistance for heavier items.
  • Travel by car and air, including overnight stays and extended international assignments.

Work Environment

Join a collaborative organization that values integrity, accountability, initiative, and innovation. This role offers the opportunity to build a growing technical function, develop talent, and lead complex projects that support critical regulated environments.

Salary: $120,000 – $135,000 / year

Soft Skills:

Education:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We are seeking a Marketing Director to lead global marketing for Falcon MLR, our agentic MLR solution. Partnering closely with marketing, strategy, and product management, you will develop the positioning, messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market strategy for Falcon MLR. You will also execute global marketing strategies that drive brand awareness, pipeline growth, and engagement with existing customers and target accounts.
You will ensure seamless territory alignment and make a measurable impact across demand generation, events, communications, and digital marketing in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and drive global marketing strategy and go-to-market execution for Falcon MLR, aligning marketing initiatives with business objectives and market opportunities
  • Own the integrated marketing strategy, partnering closely with cross-functional teams on key objectives and campaign themes
  • Create awareness, nurture, and educate key contacts within target accounts to drive pipeline growth and accelerate sales opportunities
  • Develop compelling marketing content—including customer stories, presentations, web content, videos, webinars, and sales tools—to support every stage of the customer journey
  • Partner with Product Management and Strategy to build differentiated positioning, messaging, and value propositions that speak directly to key target buyers and influencers
  • Represent the voice of the customer by bringing market insights, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback into product and marketing strategies
  • Identify and act on opportunities to improve programs and ABM effectiveness through better audience segmentation, marketing techniques, and processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Enablement, Strategy, and Marketing teams to ensure optimal orchestration and execution of global marketing programs
  • Build and maintain a complete and accurate account and contact database
  • Measure marketing performance, evaluate business impact, and continuously optimize programs to improve awareness, pipeline, and customer adoption

Requirements

  • Based in Copenhagen
  • 10+ years of enterprise B2B software marketing experience
  • Must have a proven track record of building global, multi-channel campaigns and driving strategic go-to-market execution
  • Hands-on experience spanning GTM strategy development through content creation and editing (including customer stories, presentations, web content, videos, and sales tools)
  • Deep understanding of database management, audience segmentation, and targeted nurture programs (including ABM) to accelerate pipeline growth and sales opportunities
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships and drive alignment across multiple product lines (PromoMats, Medical, MedTech) and matrixed global regions (NA & EU, LATAM, APAC)
  • Experience leading end-to-end integrated marketing programs across product launches, field programs, demand generation, webinars, events, and sales enablement
  • Demonstrated experience defining success metrics, tracking campaign performance, evaluating business impact, and continuously optimizing programs based on data and customer insights

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing high-value solutions to the life sciences industry
  • Experience with Marketo

Interviewing with Veeva

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Compensation

  • Total compensation: 210,000 - 246,000 EUR
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
#RemoteDenmark
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

raw.description:
We are hiring a Marketing Automation Engineer with hands-on experience using Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok to automate, scale, and optimize marketing and revenue-generating functions.

VIDIZMO is an AI software company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia. We build Nexus, AI Intelligence Hub, AI Live Insight and Redactor, a product family that lets an organization search, analyze, redact and act on its unstructured data, where video, audio, images, documents and text are treated as equal first-class sources rather than one format with the rest bolted on. More than 100 customers run VIDIZMO in production across public safety and justice, government, healthcare, financial services, education, legal, manufacturing and energy, and much of that installed base runs on premises, in air-gapped environments, or in FedRAMP High environments through our hosting partners, on a CJIS Security Policy-aligned architecture.

We are an independent software vendor. We build and support the software, and the channel sells it, with qualified partners also installing, delivering and supporting deployments for their own clients. That model shapes almost every role here: the people we hire spend their time making partners and customers successful rather than pushing paper through a direct sales funnel.

Role Overview

This role is for someone who understands Large Language Models (LLMs) not just as tools, but as both business enablers and things you build with - equally able to write the code that automates a workflow and to use that automation to market, position, and sell complex SaaS products. Whether your primary background is software engineering or marketing/growth, a real hands-on experience on both sides will be a plus.

You will be responsible for turning AI into a distribution, demand generation, and sales enablement engine for VIDIZMO's products - not only by prompting AI chat tools, but by engineering the automations, integrations, and workflows that let content, personalization, and sales enablement run at scale with minimal manual work. That means deeply learning VIDIZMO products, the competitive landscape, customer pain points, and market positioning, then building and operating the AI-driven systems that market and sell VIDIZMO at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scripts and integrations (Python/JavaScript) that connect the marketing and sales stack - CRM, CMS, analytics, email, and AI tools - via their APIs and webhooks
  • Use Claude Code to build custom AI agents and multi-step workflows.
  • Stand up and maintain workflow-orchestration pipelines (e.g. Zapier, Make, n8n, or custom code) that trigger content updates, personalization, or outreach based on product, CRM, or website events.
  • Keep automations under version control, document them, and monitor them for failures so they run reliably without manual babysitting
  • Evaluate build-vs-buy tradeoffs for new automation needs and prototype quickly using AI-assisted coding

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or maintaining internal tools, browser extensions, or lightweight web apps
  • Familiarity with a marketing automation or CRM platform's API (HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, etc.), not just its UI
  • Exposure to CI/CD basics, cron jobs/schedulers, or serverless functions (for scheduled or event-driven marketing automations)
  • Proficient with SEO and organic growth strategies
  • Familiarity with agentic AI workflows, RAG-based knowledge systems, and competitive intelligence tooling

Success Metrics

  • Number and reliability of automations/workflows shipped and kept running (uptime, error rate)
  • Time saved or manual effort removed from recurring marketing/sales tasks through automation
  • Speed and quality of product messaging.
  • Discoverability of VIDIZMO innovations.
  • Sales enablement effectiveness and real impact on demand and revenue.

Required Qualifications (Must-Have)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of total professional experience combining software development and marketing/growth in B2B SaaS - at least 1.5 years hands-on coding (writing, testing, and shipping code, not just using no-code tools) and at least 2 years in a product/growth marketing or GTM role.
  • Working proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python or JavaScript/Node preferred), and comfort reading/adapting code written by an AI agent
  • Practical experience calling and integrating REST APIs, and familiarity with git/version control
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, and with AI chat tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok) for content and research
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, generative AI concepts, and prompt engineering, including RAG at a conceptual level
  • Proven ability to learn complex products quickly and translate technical features into business value
  • Demonstrated business aptitude: understanding buyer intent, revenue-focused thinking, and the ability to support sales, not just marketing
  • Comfortable operating in a hands-on, high-ownership role

Why Join US?

  • Own the narrative and growth of mission-critical products
  • Work closely with executive leadership on strategy and execution
  • Influence product direction through market insight
  • Operate in high-impact markets with real-world outcomes
  • Opportunity to build and scale product marketing as a growth engine

Benefits:Health Insurance (OPD/IPD), Daily Lunch Facility, Separate Maternity Cover, Leave encashment, Car Support Program, Referral Bonus, EOBI, Bi-Annual Increment. Provident Fund, Career Growth, Bonus (benefits vary based on location)

WR Immigration is a global immigration firm known worldwide for its innovation, technology, and high touch legal services. With offices across multiple time zones, the firm provides corporate global visa services in over 100 countries. WR is one of the fastest growing immigration service providers worldwide with over 46 attorneys and 200 immigration professionals working out of offices in Boston, Denver, Los Angeles, New York, Oakland, San Diego, San Francisco, Santa Monica, and Shanghai.

Associate Attorneys work alongside Legal Assistants, Paralegals, Team Managers, Partners, and other Associates to prepare and file a variety of business-related non-immigrant and immigrant visa petitions, including taking a leading role in client communication, working closely with legal support teams to ensure understanding of general and specific case strategies, and conducting high-level case reviews of work done by legal support teams. We are looking to add an Associate Attorney to our growing team; remote applicants will be considered, with preference given to candidates in Mountain or Pacific Time Zones.

Associate Attorney Responsibilities:

  • Analyzing and communicating options to address clients’ business immigration needs
  • Maintaining timely and accurate lines of communications with clients both during and after the application process to provide support with immigration program management and compliance
  • Supervising and collaborating with supporting staff to ensure that applications are prepared and filed correctly
  • Maintaining accuracy for high volume, rapid turnover cases
  • Assisting clients and staff with questions throughout the filing process
  • Other duties as required

Requirements:

  • Valid membership in an applicable Bar association
  • 5+ years of business immigration experience
  • Strong knowledge across a broad range of nonimmigrant visa matters, including H-1B, L-1A/L-1B, E-2 Treaty Investor, O-1, TN, E-3, and J-1 matters
  • Strong knowledge of employment-based permanent residence matters, including PERM, EB-1A, EB-1B, EB-1C, NIW, and adjustment of status
  • Significant experience handling complex RFEs, NOIDs, and other challenging case issues
  • Experience working directly with startups and smaller corporate clients, including advising on immigration strategy as companies grow
  • Proven track record of success in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent communication and writing skills
  • Strong organization skills
  • Experience managing multiple competing priorities independently
  • Excellent attention to detail and interpersonal skills

Interested applicants will be required to submit a resume, cover letter, and writing sample. The anticipated salary range for this position is between $160,000 and $200,000 per year.

Benefits:

WR Immigration offers a robust and competitive suite of benefits designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our team members. Benefits for full-time employees include paid time off and paid holidays; medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage; health savings and flexible spending accounts to help offset healthcare and dependent care expenses; multiple retirement plan options (401k & Roth 401k); and access to an employee assistance program. Benefits availability and eligibility may vary based on role and employment status.

Additional Information:

WR Immigration is committed to creating, fostering, and preserving an inclusive environment. We support our team members from all nations and backgrounds to achieve their goals and build lives of purpose and success. We recognize that our team members bring diverse talents, skills, and experiences, and we believe it is our responsibility to create an inclusive and respectful workplace that inspires excellence and compassion, both internally and in our service to clients.

Please note, we are not working with outside recruiters for this position.

WR Immigration does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. The firm will not be responsible for any referral fees or other compensation in the absence of a signed agreement between WR Immigration and the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes submitted without such an agreement, including those sent directly to hiring managers, will be considered the property of WR Immigration, and the firm reserves the right to pursue and hire candidates submitted in this manner without financial obligation.

Salary: $160,000 - $200,000 DOE

raw.description:
Matthew 25 has been recognized as a top workplace 4 years in a row—and we’re just getting started! Come join our mission-driven team!

At Matthew 25, we’re proud to offer a benefits package designed to support our employees both professionally and personally:

  • Competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience
  • No required overtime ever—we value work-life balance
  • Professional growth opportunities, including company-sponsored continuing education and development programs
  • A mission-focused workplace where every team member is dedicated to serving our community

Join us and make a difference every day while thriving in a supportive, rewarding work environment!

Matthew 25’s Mission:

“We exist to serve those at risk for, living with, or impacted by HIV or other STIs through comprehensive healthcare, education, and support while fostering community partnerships to combat stigma and improve overall healthcare and quality of life.”

Matthew 25’s Vision:

“Our vision is to exist in communities where comprehensive HIV and STI prevention is widespread, ensuring universal access to high-quality, comprehensive healthcare and supportive services. We aim for those living with HIV to achieve undetectable status, resulting in zero new HIV diagnoses, and to eliminate new STI infections. We are the trusted resource for HIV and STI services, fostering a culture of love, service, and hope in every interaction.”

Overview:

Provides medical case management services under the Kentucky HIV/AIDS Care Coordination Program (KHCCP), including social service assessments and connecting HIV+ individuals with needed services offered by Federal, State, and Local community programs.

This position is "As Needed" and hours will differ from month to month.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Conduct nutrition assessments with clients and identify nutritional diagnoses.
  2. Meet with patients who have nutritional needs based on their clinical nutritional assessment and provide counseling, suggestions, and resources.
  3. Develop individualized plans and goals for nutrition interventions and therapies for clients.
  4. Promote better nutrition by speaking to clients about diet, nutrition, and the relationship between good eating habits and managing HIV/AIDS as well as other related health issues.
  1. Evaluate the effectiveness and measure progress toward outcomes of medical nutrition therapy interventions and make changes as indicated
  2. Will utilize assessment and evaluation techniques that consider the varied needs of age-specific populations, as well as cultural, religious, and ethnic concerns

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human nutrition, food and nutrition, dietetics, food systems management, or an equivalent major course of study.
  • Registered Dietitian (RD) through the Commission on Dietitian Registration (CDR) of the American Dietetic Association (ADA).
  • Licensure as a dietitian with the Kentucky and Indiana Board of Licensure and Certification for Dietitians and Nutritionists.
    Experience working in a nonprofit organization or a strong desire to work in a service-driven environment.
  • 100% Commitment to Matthew 25's mission, vision, and values
  • Must be able to pass a drug screen and background check.

raw.description:
Campaign Director, Switzerland

📍 Location: Remote, DACH

⏳ Work Type: Full-time, flexible hours

Are you ready to lead national campaigns that defend life, protect the family, and safeguard fundamental freedoms in Switzerland?

CitizenGO is seeking a bold and strategic Campaign Director to lead our work in Switzerland. This is your opportunity to run high-impact national and global campaigns, mobilize thousands of citizens, and ensure that the voices of our supporters translate into real cultural and political change.

As Campaign Director, you will be at the heart of one of the most innovative and fast-growing advocacy movements in the world. You will not just write petitions. You will shape public debate, influence decision-makers, and represent CitizenGO in your country.

If you want your work to matter every single day, we want to hear from you.

About the Role

Campaign Directors are at the core of CitizenGO’s advocacy work. In Switzerland, you will take full ownership of your designated list, running national and global online campaigns that are read by millions of people each week.

You will track political and cultural developments, craft powerful campaign communications, and mobilize supporters to take action. You will also prepare or translate campaign messages from English, ensuring they resonate deeply within the Swiss context.

Beyond online campaigns, you will help organize offline actions such as petition deliveries and public stunts, build coalitions with like-minded organizations, and engage in legislative and electoral processes to highlight and defend our values.

In summary, you will serve as the public representative of CitizenGO in Switzerland.

This role reports to the Manager of Global Campaigns and offers a flexible schedule, provided all responsibilities are fulfilled on time and with excellence.

Why Join CitizenGO?

At CitizenGO, you will be part of a dynamic, mission-driven team committed to creating real change. Here are the top 10 reasons why working with us is a unique and rewarding experience:

  1. Make an Impact: Your work will directly contribute to defending life, family, and freedom on a global scale.
  2. We’re Winning: You will join a successful team! Our campaigning works, and we’re changing politics and policies across the world. Check out some of our recent victories here.
  3. Bold Tactics: From petitions to street rallies, we employ bold, effective strategies to win.
  4. Independent Strategy: Our actions are driven by our members, not large funders, ensuring we prioritize what’s best for the world.
  5. Fearless in the Face of Opposition: We thrive in challenging environments, fearlessly facing off against powerful adversaries without backing down.
  6. Inspiring Teammates: You will work alongside helpful, kind, motivated, and talented individuals who share your values.
  7. Remote Flexibility: You will enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere, eliminating commutes and allowing you the flexibility to travel and live on your terms.
  8. Flexible Hours: You will benefit from adaptable work hours, ensuring you can be there for others and manage your day as you see fit.
  9. Connected Community: Though fully remote, our team fosters a strong sense of camaraderie.
  10. Results-Focused Culture: We prioritize efficiency and impact, ensuring a balanced work-life dynamic.

Seeour culture pagefor more!

What You'll Do

  • You will research, conceive, develop, and run campaigns on a range of national and global issues, helping to channel our members' time and donations in the most effective ways possible.
  • You will monitor local and global events to identify opportunities for strong and timely campaigns.
  • You will consult with experts and support the development of a strong strategy, policy, and messaging.
  • You will draft, proofread, and edit campaign emails and other marketing communications.
  • You will draft, proofread, and edit prompts to be used with Artificial Intelligence to generate and enhance emails, communications, and other written materials.
  • You will look for and identify relevant, issue-specific supporting materials from the press, NGOs, and other credible sources.
  • You will send emails to CitizenGO’s supporters in your country to inform them about new campaigns and the results of ongoing efforts.
  • You will propose offline actions, from ad buys to public petition deliveries and other campaign-related initiatives.
  • You will coordinate materials in your country's language, including briefings to the Campaigns team, press releases, and research documents.
  • You will engage in public speaking and media activities when needed.
  • You will establish and strengthen connections with influencers, journalists, and activists on social media to enhance the reach of our campaigns.
  • You will translate CitizenGO’s global campaigns and emails from English into your country’s language, if applicable.
  • You will manage correspondence and consultation processes with members, including polling and feedback initiatives.
  • You will help shape the overall strategic direction of the organization and, when needed, support additional tasks such as recruitment, team building, management, and special projects.
  • You will establish coalitions with like-minded organizations to strengthen the mobilization and confrontational politics central to CitizenGO’s model.
  • You will propose, assist, and advise Media Campaigners on offline events and campaign-related performances, attending events and taking ownership of offline actions when necessary for logistical reasons.
  • You will review, manage, and support petitions published by members on the CitizenGO Petitions website.
  • You will monitor the CitizenGO website for functionality and language accuracy, including typos and grammatical errors.
  • You will train and support your Campaign Associate, if applicable, organize the strategy for your list, and collaborate to enhance growth, engagement, and brand visibility.
  • You will build and improve workflows with AI and manage AI Agents effectively to multiply output and quality.

Who you are

  • You are based in Switzerland and speak German as a first language.
  • You have the availability to travel for offlines (on-site events) once a month.
  • You have at least a B2-level proficiency in English. (Duolingo English Test required for non-natives, minimum score of 100). Spanish and other languages are a plus.
  • You have enthusiasm for and broad experience with software tools, along with proven ability to quickly learn and adapt to new ones.
  • You possess strong strategic, creative, and innovative thinking skills, with the ability to analyze socio-political scenarios, develop complex ideas, and communicate them clearly.
  • You have a solid understanding of how civic advocacy, citizen mobilization, and grassroots campaigning function.
  • You are passionate about and deeply committed to defending life, family, and freedom.
  • You demonstrate high professionalism, self-motivation, efficiency, and results-oriented delivery, even on short timelines.
  • You have strong teamwork skills and are comfortable in a highly collaborative team culture within a hierarchical team structure.
  • You possess strong project and staff management skills.
  • You are able to adjust quickly to changing conditions and requirements.
  • You are willing and able to work autonomously on a variety of tasks and projects, prioritizing them efficiently.
  • You are proactive, take the initiative to get the job done, and contribute valuable projects and proposals that enrich the entire organization.
  • You have strong user-level computer skills; experience with Google Workspace is preferred, and proficiency in CRMs and project management tools is an asset.
  • You have a flexible schedule and are able to work under tight deadlines, including availability for evening and weekend work and occasional travel as needed.
  • You have previous experience in copywriting and producing marketing content, which is considered an asset.
  • You have proficiency in using Artificial Intelligence tools to generate emails, communications, and other written materials, which is considered an asset.

Benefits

  • Work from anywhere – Enjoy the flexibility of remote work.
  • Flexible hours – Manage your own schedule.
  • 24 vacation days per year plus local public holidays.
  • Tuition reimbursement – Up to €500 per year for professional development.
  • Language courses – Monthly allowance for English or Spanish iTalki lessons ($120 monthly).
  • One free book per month – Up to €30 each.
  • Home office setup allowance – €500 every two years to optimize your workspace.
  • Coworking membership support – Up to €200 per month.
  • Access to cutting-edge AI tools – Access advanced Artificial Intelligence resources to support your day-to-day work.
  • Annual retreats and networking events – Team meetups, retreats, and networking events throughout the year.

How to Apply

Click the Apply for this job button, fill out the application, and include your resume. Successful candidates will proceed through the following steps:

  1. First interview with PeopleOps.
  2. Second interview with the Manager of Global Campaigns.
  3. Campaign drafting task to assess copywriting skills.
  4. Third interview with the Director of Global Campaigns.
  5. Duolingo English Test
  6. Offer extended to the final candidate.

Recruitment Process Timeline

The hiring process typically takes 2 to 8 weeks from the first interview to the final decision. Timelines may vary depending on holidays, the number of candidates, and the level and complexity of the role.

For information about our privacy practices in the recruitment process, please visit ourRecruitment Privacy Policy page.
