Oracle Cloud Financial Delivery Lead

JOB SUMMARY:

A Delivery Lead at Argano is a highly experienced professional in the consulting family responsible for providing solution leadership to mid-to-large-size client engagements and contributing to the growth and development of the consulting practice. The ideal candidate will be a consummate professional who can thrive in an upbeat and innovative environment and collaborate with clients to deliver a state-of-the-art solution. The individual will excel at delivering high-quality service and cutting-edge solutions to Argano clients in the Oracle community. They will accomplish this by providing expert advice, guidance, and solutions related to technology to businesses and organizations and identify and apply creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles. Their goal is to help clients optimize their technology infrastructure, processes, and strategies to achieve their business objectives more efficiently and effectively.

If you're energized by architecting bold, creative solutions to the toughest implementation and integration challenges — and you're ready to bring that vision to Argano's most complex client engagements — we want to hear from you!

Please note: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides functional leadership and oversight to the financial functional team members in successfully implementing a wide range of Oracle Finance Cloud applications across different industries for complex, mid to large-size implementations oftentimes simultaneously on multiple engagements
  • Has extensive experience in leading Oracle Cloud Application requirements workshops, solutions architecture & design discussions
  • Using in-depth knowledge of Oracle Cloud Applications, as well as industry best practice expertise, consults with clients to provide cost effective solutions to client business scenarios.
  • Leads the implementation team in creating the overall Enterprise Cloud solution. This includes both technical and functional solutions.
  • Has solid experience in extending Oracle Cloud Applications, such as with PaaS and other extension approaches and technologies. This involves designing solutions and writing specifications to create custom applications and integrating them with Oracle Cloud Applications.
  • Analyzes current systems and data to identify new requirements, recognizing the need for systems enhancements or modifications if necessary.
  • Leads, mentors, trains and guides the Oracle Cloud applications implementation team on the ground
  • Provides thought leadership and identifies and applies creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles and problems.
  • Develops and implements long-term client strategies
  • Acts as the primary point of contact for clients. Effectively communicate with clients, team members, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Keep all parties informed about project progress, challenges, and changes.
  • Actively engages project stakeholders in the estimation process, being mindful of the impact of strategic business changes.
  • Supports business partners in presenting solution value to key stakeholders effectively.
  • Collaborates with third-party vendors and suppliers to source necessary hardware, software, or services. Negotiates contracts and agreements to secure the best terms for the client.
  • Presents compelling business cases, clearly quantifying the benefits of proposed solutions.
  • Continuously monitors the performance of implemented solutions to identify areas for improvement or optimization. Provides recommendations for updates, upgrades, or modifications as needed.

MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, etc.
  • MBA, relevant master's degree or PhD.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum 10 years of experience as a Oracle Functional consultant with 3+ years of experience in leading financial solution design for Oracle cloud implementations.
  • Expert level experience as an Oracle Cloud Architect implementing or supporting Oracle Cloud implementation projects and upgrades.

  • Experience with Oracle Platform as a Service (PaaS) with a focus on Integration Cloud Service, Database Cloud Service

  • Knowledgeable and experienced with Web Services and the use of Oracle Cloud delivered Web Services (SOAP & REST)

  • Expert consulting experience and business analytical skills to gather and document business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, business process designs, managing conference room pilots (CRPs), perform functional configuration, and manage testing of procurement ERP solutions.

  • Experience in navigating the challenges of working with cross-border and diverse teams and projects.

  • Expert level knowledge and experience with at least 2 of the following Oracle Cloud Application modules:

    • Oracle Accounts Receivables

    • Oracle General Ledger

    • Oracle Accounts Payables

    • Oracle Fixed Assets

    • Oracle PPM

    • Oracle Cash Management

    • Oracle Expenses and Collections

  • Strong consulting experience and business analytical skills to gather and document business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, business process designs, managing conference room pilots, performing functional configuration, and managing the testing of Oracle Financial Cloud solutions.

  • Proven experience with guiding clients through business process improvements

  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills

  • High commitment to exceed performance expectations.

  • Professional approach when dealing with internal and external customers.

  • Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.

  • Willingness to travel as needed.

  • Preferred consulting experience in a similar role in a professional services firm or industry experience at a strategic level is required.

  • Creating a positive environment by monitoring workloads of the team while meeting client expectations.

  • Experience in the Aerospace and Defense Industry highly preferred

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

Oracle Cloud certifications preferred

SKILL REQUIREMENTS

  • Communication: Proficient in English written and verbal communications. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.

  • Complex Project Management: Delivery Leads are responsible for leading multiple complex projects, necessitating exceptional project management skills.

  • Thought Leadership: Providing thought leadership and industry expertise is critical in projects.

  • Client Acquisition: They should have strong business development skills to acquire new clients and expand existing relationships.

  • Mentorship and Coaching: Indirectly developing and coaching junior and mid-level consultants is a significant responsibility.

  • Strategic Vision: Delivery Leads should contribute to the firm's strategic vision and decision-making.

  • Executive Presence: The ability to interact effectively with senior client executives is important.

raw.description:
Elevate the Future with Lesaffre

For over 170 years, Lesaffre has been a pioneering force in the world of fermentation, harnessing the power of microorganisms to transform industries from baking to healthcare. As a key global player, we've built a presence in 96 countries, employing 11,000 passionate innovators who share our unwavering commitment to excellence.

Driven by our core values of passion, respect, trust, entrepreneurship, and humility, we're constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible. Our 3-billion euro enterprise collaborates with visionary customers, partners, and researchers to develop essential nutrients and bioactives that strengthen human health, optimize animal well-being, and improve plant nutrition.

Discover Agrauxine!

Agrauxine develops, manufactures, and commercializes innovative solutions for biocontrol, biostimulation, and bionutrition based on microorganisms or their derivatives. Driven by a deep understanding of microbiology and a commitment to sustainable agriculture, Agrauxine's team harnesses the power of nature to create high-performance, eco-friendly products that address the evolving needs of farmers and growers worldwide. From microbial-based biopesticides to biostimulants that enhance plant growth and resilience, Agrauxine's solutions leverage the latest biotechnology advancements to deliver tangible benefits to agricultural productivity and profitability. By collaborating closely with customers, Agrauxine develops customized offerings that seamlessly integrate into existing farming practices, promoting sustainable practices and contributing to a healthier, more abundant food supply.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to represent a passionate organization focused on innovation and sustainability
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits starting on day one, including health, dental, vision, and 401(k) with employer match
  • 11 paid holidays
  • The ability to leverage your expertise and make a tangible, meaningful impact on the business and our sustainability initiatives
  • Opportunities for continuous growth and development, including the ability to take on new challenges and collaborate across our international business units

How You'll Contribute to Our Success

As an Account Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving Agrauxine’s commercial growth and market leadership across the USA, Canada, and Puerto Rico. With your strategic mindset and hands-on approach, you’ll manage and expand key customer accounts, deepening relationships with distributors and unlocking new revenue opportunities. By leveraging your agricultural distribution expertise and market insights, you’ll identify high-value business prospects, negotiate win-win agreements, and execute targeted commercial strategies that deliver measurable sales results. Your ability to operate independently, prioritize effectively, and build trust with customers and internal teams will strengthen partnerships and position Agrauxine as a preferred partner in the crop inputs space. With a focus on results and long-term growth, you’ll directly impact our success by expanding market reach, optimizing account performance, and contributing to Agrauxine’s leadership in North America.

What You’ll do as North America Account Manager

  • Safety and Compliance
    • Uphold Lesaffre’s safety-first culture by following all protocols and participating in required safety programs
  • Accounts & Customer Management
    • Manage a portfolio of strategic customers, distributors, and channel partners to drive revenue growth
    • Build trusted relationships with key decision-makers and execute account-specific business plans
    • Conduct regular business reviews, track performance, and identify growth opportunities
    • Serve as the primary commercial contact, ensuring responsiveness and high customer service standards
    • Negotiate pricing, contracts, and agreements within company guidelines.
  • Sales Execution & Revenue Growth
    • Own and deliver against assigned sales targets and growth objectives
    • Proactively identify and convert new business opportunities within existing and prospective accounts
    • Maintain a strong sales pipeline with clear timelines and conversion plans
    • Resolve commercial barriers and accelerate product adoption with distributors and customers
  • Distributor & Channel Development
    • Strengthen relationships with existing distributors and optimize channel performance
    • Collaborate with distributor teams to support product positioning, training, and sales execution
    • Identify and evaluate new channel partners and strategic customers
  • Market Knowledge & Business Development
    • Stay current on North American agricultural input trends, including biologicals, biostimulants, and plant nutrition
    • Monitor competitive activity, customer needs, and emerging market opportunities
    • Provide market intelligence to support commercial decision-making
    • Represent Agrauxine at industry events, trade shows, and customer meetings
  • Commercial Planning & Accountability
    • Prepare accurate sales forecasts and demand planning inputs
    • Develop and execute measurable account plans with clear revenue objectives
    • Maintain customer records, opportunity tracking, and reporting in company systems
    • Collaborate with Supply Chain, Marketing, and Technical teams to ensure customer commitments are met
    • Demonstrate commitment to Lesaffre’s values, ethical business practices, and safety culture

Required qualifications:

  • Education Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Agronomy, Plant Science, Business, Marketing, or related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience
  • Minimum of 5 years of successful B2B sales or key account management experience within the agricultural input industry focusing on crop protection, seeds, and/or fertilizers
  • Demonstrated track record of achieving sales targets, developing strategic accounts, and delivering profitable revenue growth
  • Established knowledge of the North American agricultural distribution landscape, including manufacturers, distributors, and channel partners
  • Proven ability to manage complex customer relationships and negotiate commercial agreements
  • Experience managing sales pipelines, customer forecasts, and account plans
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% of the time throughout North America, with occasional international travel

raw.description:
Role: Regional Recruitment Manager,

Location: Pakistan - Remote,

Job type: Contract (12 months)

Why QS?

At QS, we believe that work should empower you. That’s why we foster a flexible working environment that encourages every employee to own their career whilst flourishing personally and professionally. Our company values underpin everything we do – we collaborate, respect and support each other.

It’s our mission to empower motivated people around the world to fulfil their potential through higher education, ensuring that everyone has access to opportunities that change lives.

Our diversity makes us stronger. By sharing our experiences, we learn from one another and achieve more together, driving progress across the sector.

At QS, you’ll be responsible for implementing real changes in the international higher education landscape. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that see a positive impact across the business and the wider sector.

We’re confident you’ll feel right at home here. QS was named as one of Newsweek’s Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® in the UK (October 2023), recognizing the respect, trust and appreciation that drive our culture every day. And as a gold-accredited Investors in People organization – putting us among the top 28% of workplaces globally – it’s official: QS is a place where everyone can thrive.

As a Regional Recruitment Manager, this is what you’ll be doing:

Position Summary

As the Regional Recruitment Manager – Pakistan & Middle East, you will be assigned to representing Sunway University, work closely with University’s International Recruitment Office supporting recruitment and conversion activities. You will help the University’s International Recruitment Office at all stages of their student recruitment process, including maintaining of best practices and confidentiality of university data. You will be engaged in delegated marketing and outreach activities, database maintenance, and other initiatives undertaken by the client to enhance their footprint in Pakistan & Middle East.

About Sunway University

Sunway University is one of Malaysia’s leading private universities dedicated to providing quality holistic education for all regardless of race, creed or financial standing. By upholding our core values of Integrity, Humility and Excellence, we support the discovery, advancement, transmission and application of knowledge that meets the needs of our society and the global community. Our values-based education guides our actions and behaviour. We strive to ensure our campus community develops a sustainable mindset by embracing an ecological worldview, by understanding systems perspective and by developing emotional intelligence.

Sunway University is part of the Sunway Education Group which is owned and governed by the Jeffrey Cheah Foundation (JCF), Malaysia’s largest education-focused social enterprise. Through this unique not-for-profit structure, operating surpluses are channelled back into the institutions or disbursed as scholarships, research grants and expansion funds for faculty and facilities to ensure quality education in perpetuity.

Main Responsibilities

  • Participating in recruitment and outreach events (both online and in person) for prospective students, their parents and counsellors.
  • Work closely with the University’s International Recruitment Office in identifying and implement the University’s plan for enhancement and growth of international institutional engagements in the designated regions within Pakistan & Middle East.
  • Provide prompt, comprehensive, accurate information and advice to students who apply to study in international universities and education agents.
  • Provide student counselling support, and follow up on matters like offer acceptance, additional document requirements and other admission-related matters via various communication channels.
  • Maintain excellent ‘customer service’ by answering all enquiries from prospective students and parents met during recruitment fairs. Post this, initiate follow up contact with them to build the application database and nurture students through the applicant journey
  • Utilize the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system to proactively target and nurture assigned leads and applicants.
  • Building an effective working relationship with a range of stakeholders in the country’s education sector
  • Attend education events, tradeshows, conferences, webinars, virtual events and represent the university as and when required.
  • Engage in social media activities and online training as per the university’s requirement.
  • Assist in hosting online and offline events and information sessions. Assist with localized content and promotions, including maintaining databases for post event follow-up.
  • Carry out post activity follow up, including compiling data of interested students. Preparing and submitting reports on activity outcomes to the University.
  • Liaise and coordinate with appropriate internal teams for administrative issues.
  • Support towards online research, gathering market intelligence, information management, updating databases, presentations, events and conferences.
  • Conduct activities within the given budget and costs and keep track of project expenses.
  • Maintain communication with other stakeholders and keep updated with the latest on ground relevant market information.
  • Information and Reporting
  • Develop and maintain a key contacts list and share a report with the university according to the agreed frequency or as and when necessary.
  • Recording information from recruitment events and campaigns.
  • Maintain and record project progress and submit relevant reports as specified.
  • Collecting prospective leads from events, and record interactions with students and applicants in the CRM system.

Qualifications & experience required

Essential Requirements

  • Educated to first degree level
  • Experience of working in student recruitment or in a similar environment.
  • Prior experience working in the education sector (preferably in administrative, managerial, or marketing role).
  • Ability to work under pressure; to build relationships and influence across all levels of organizations (internally and externally).
  • Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.
  • High English proficiency with excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills with high attention to detail.
  • IT literacy and adequately conversant with Microsoft Office: Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Knowledge of the Pakistan & Middle East Higher Education system.
  • Collaborative working style to motivate teams to strive towards their goals.
  • Ability to manage high workloads, meet deadlines, the capacity to resolve work issues and attention to detail.
  • Flexibility in working outside of normal working office hours and or weekends, and expected high travelling frequency, due to events participation.
  • Flexibility, adaptability, and the ability to work on self-initiative and as part of a team.
  • Committed and driven.
  • Legal right to work in Pakistan on full-time basis.

Desirable Requirements

  • Relevant postgraduate or professional qualification in business or marketing.
  • Overseas study or living experience.
  • Knowledge of the Malaysia Higher Education system and Malaysia as a study destination is highly desirable
  • Experience of developing marketing campaigns and using social media as a communication tool.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the higher education system and understanding of the range of issues relevant to students contemplating studying overseas
  • Strong planning ability around developing and implementing strategic and tactical plans.
  • Good interpersonal skills including networking and relationship management.

Please note, if you don't meet all the criteria but believe you have the skills and passion to thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply.

So, who are we and what do we do?

QS is the world leader in higher education services, analytics, insights and intelligence. From consultancy to student mobility, academic partnerships to branding solutions, our services power both institutional and individual success.

We’re behind the world’s most widely read university rankings (Meltwater 2023). Our QS World University Rankings® reach hundreds of millions, shaping decisions and guiding futures.

Since launching in 1990, our impact and influence have only grown. Today, we work with more than 2,000 of the world’s leading higher education institutions, over 12,000 employers, and governments seeking change and socioeconomic development through higher education.

Join QS and you’ll join an 800-strong community of problem-solvers, creators, collaborators and change-makers based in 40+ countries and 11
international offices, including Australia, Malaysia, India, Romania, Singapore, France, Germany, the USA and our headquarters in London.

With every talented new hire, business acquisition and bold initiative, we’re strengthening our reach and delivering even greater value to institutions and learners worldwide. Are you ready to shape the future of higher education?

Like what you’ve heard? Great, apply now!

As a candidate, we know the application and interview process can be daunting and so it’s important that you have a great experience with us. Our dedicated Talent Team will work hard to ensure you are fully informed at all stages, and you are really excited by this opportunity to do meaningful work in the education space.

Equal opportunities

QS Quacquarelli Symonds is proud to be a fair and equal organisation where everyone has the same opportunity to achieve their full potential, irrespective of their background or personal attributes. We celebrate our diversity and believe through sharing our experiences we can learn from one another, be stronger together, and enable our business to thrive.

raw.description:
Job Description:

The Country Manager is responsible for leading the commercial strategy and execution across assigned country/countries, ensuring sustainable revenue growth, market share expansion, and customer satisfaction through effective leadership, strategic planning, and operational excellence. This includes managing sales teams and ensuring alignment with corporate goals and priorities. The role requires a strong focus on market development, customer engagement, and operational excellence to expand the presence of Ormco’s orthodontic solutions.

· Develop and execute the country-level business strategy aligned with regional and global objectives.

· Lead, coach, and develop (Sr.) Territory Managers and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

· Manage budgeting and forecasting for the country (countries).

· Build and maintain strong relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), customers.

· Collaborate with other departments to ensure effective implementation of marketing campaigns, product launches, and training programs.

· Drive sales performance through data-driven decision-making and CRM tools.

· Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and regulatory changes.

· Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.

· Ensure compliance with corporate policies and local regulations.

Job Requirements:

  • Commercial leadership experience within the medical devices, life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Strong financial acumen and experience managing budgets and forecasts.
  • Deep understanding of sales strategy, market development, and customer engagement.
  • Experience working with direct sales models and distributors.
  • Fluent in English and local language(s) of the country/countries managed.
  • Excellent computer skills (in Excel and CRM).
  • Experience to operate in an international environment.

Operating Company:

Ormco

Ormco is a global leader and innovator of high-quality orthodontic products and solutions, including brackets and wires. For more than 60 years, our team has partnered with the orthodontic community to help create over 20 million smiles in more than 140 countries. We build trusted relationships. Each one is rooted in respect and understanding. We take that approach when we help orthodontists achieve their clinical and practice management objectives. We take the same approach when we help our team bring their personal best to work each day, ready to make a difference and reach their full potential.

Envista will consider unsolicited referrals and/or resumes submitted by vendors such as search firms, staffing agencies, professional recruiters, fee-based referral services and recruiting agencies (Agency) to have been referred by the Agency free of charge and Envista will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt such unsolicited resumes. An Agency must obtain advance written approval from Envista's internal Talent Acquisition or Human Resources team to submit resumes, and then only in conjunction with a valid fully-executed contract approved by the Global Talent Acquisition leader and in response to a specific job opening. Envista will not pay a fee to any Agency that does not have such agreement and written approval in place.

raw.title: AI Evaluation & Annotation Reviewer (L3 - Advanced Level) - Italian
raw.excerpt: Launch Your Career in Artificial Intelligence We are seeking language professionals who are available and prepared to commit to this project for a minimum of six months.
raw.description:
Launch Your Career in Artificial Intelligence

We are seeking language professionals who are available and prepared to commit to this project for a minimum of six months. This is a long-term engagement that requires consistent attendance, dependable availability, and the ability to work the required schedule throughout the project.

Artificial Intelligence is transforming how the world communicates, learns, and solves problems—and skilled reviewers play an important role in improving the quality of these systems.

As an AI Evaluation & Annotation Reviewer, you will evaluate AI-generated content, identify linguistic and structural issues, annotate language data, and provide feedback that helps make AI responses more accurate, relevant, and reliable.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in linguistics, translation, localization, language education, research, writing, or quality assurance who are interested in gaining hands-on experience on a real-world AI project.

Why Join This Project?

  • Gain practical experience working on a global Artificial Intelligence project.
  • Build valuable skills in AI evaluation, annotation, prompt review, and language quality.
  • Work directly with QA Leads, international teams, and client stakeholders.
  • Strengthen your experience for future opportunities in AI, language technology, localization, research, and quality assurance.
  • Receive project-specific training, guidance, and ongoing feedback.

What You’ll Do

  • Review AI-generated responses for clarity, accuracy, correctness, relevance, and overall quality.
  • Annotate and label language content according to detailed project guidelines.
  • Generate or evaluate prompts based on assignment requirements.
  • Identify linguistic errors, dataset concerns, and structural inconsistencies.
  • Provide clear, structured feedback to support improvements in AI performance.
  • Communicate complex language requirements clearly to both linguistic and non-linguistic stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with QA Leads and clients to apply feedback and maintain quality standards.
  • Participate in required client-facing meetings with your camera on.
  • Submit daily work reports and consistently meet productivity and quality expectations.

What We’re Looking For

  • Professional fluency in Italian with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Linguistics, Languages, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • A degree or certification in Italian, where required.
  • Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • The ability to identify patterns, errors, inconsistencies, and subtle language issues.
  • Experience in annotation, evaluation, translation, localization, linguistics, research, education, or quality assurance is helpful but not required.
  • An interest in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, language technology, or data annotation.
  • The ability to learn new tools, follow detailed guidelines, and adapt to changing project requirements.
  • Strong organization and task-management skills.
  • Professional communication skills and confidence participating in client-facing meetings.
  • The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with a global team.

Schedule and Commitment Requirements

Applicants must be able to meet all of the following requirements:

  • Commit to the project for a minimum of six months.
  • Maintain consistent availability throughout the engagement.
  • Work consecutive eight-hour shifts.
  • Remain available during the required core hours of 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST.
  • Attend daily client meetings scheduled between 10:00 AM–12:00 PM PST.
  • Consistently meet attendance, productivity, quality, and reporting expectations.

Only approved and properly logged hours will be compensated. This is an independent contractor engagement and does not include paid holidays or paid time off.

Compensation Range

Rates vary by language and are confirmed based on project requirements.

Italian - $14 to $16.00 USD per hour


Ready to Apply?

This opportunity is best suited for individuals who are genuinely interested in language and Artificial Intelligence and can provide the consistency required for a long-term global project.

Apply if you are ready to commit for at least six months, meet the required schedule, and contribute dependable, high-quality work throughout the engagement.


Location Restrictions

We are unable to accept applicants currently residing in:

Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, Iran, Iraq, North Korea, Mexico, Panama, Russia, Sudan, Syria, Ukraine (Crimea, Luhansk, Donetsk), United Kingdom, Venezuela.

raw.excerpt: Position Purpose: Accountable for defining, executing, and continuously advancing Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) processes to align portfolio initiatives with organizational objectives.
raw.description:
Position Purpose: Accountable for defining, executing, and continuously advancing Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) processes to align portfolio initiatives with organizational objectives. Establishes and drives data driven decision making, optimizes process efficiency and establishes robust mechanisms to monitor portfolio health enabling maximum value realization and achievement of strategic goals.

Key Details: Partners across business, technology, finance, and transformation teams to improve governance effectiveness, strategic alignment, portfolio transparency, and execution outcomes while supporting enterprise initiatives from planning through operationalization. Preferred experience includes supporting executive leadership teams in Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), corporate strategy, business transformation, governance and operating model design, business operations, and organizational effectiveness.

  • Execute the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of new and existing Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) processes, driving tool adoption while ensuring alignment with guiding principles, governance frameworks, and organizational strategy.
  • Architect, document, and deliver clear, impactful communication of processes, governance updates, executive reporting, controls, and strategic recommendations to stakeholders, leadership teams, and end users.
  • Orchestrate collaboration across process owners and interfacing teams, synchronizing improvement initiatives while driving alignment across business, technology, finance, and transformation stakeholders.
  • Validate process designs, including the correct business requirements, ensuring scalability and alignment with strategic needs.
  • Prioritize technical backlog for future enhancements to portfolio management processes while identifying opportunities to improve governance capabilities, reporting effectiveness, and organizational execution.
  • Coordinate alignment between organizational strategy and operational execution, enabling agile decision making around budgets, resource prioritization, investments, and portfolio outcomes.
  • Coordinate defining and communicating the process mission, vision, tactics, goals, objectives, and KPIs, ensuring they remain tightly aligned with enterprise strategies and transformation priorities.
  • Oversee portfolio process health proactively ensuring alignment with strategic priorities, organizational roadmaps, governance policies, and quality standards.
  • Develop executive-level reporting, presentations, business cases, governance materials, and decision-support content to facilitate leadership alignment, portfolio transparency, and informed decision making.
  • Deliver in-depth insights and provide actionable recommendations on portfolio reports, with a focus on the health, performance, value realization, risks, and outcomes of portfolios, sub-portfolios, and projects.
  • Support governance forums, strategic planning activities, leadership reviews, and transformation initiatives through stakeholder coordination, action tracking, issue resolution, and execution oversight.
  • Champion transformative business process changes, governance enhancements, and capability investments that elevate process maturity, strengthen organizational effectiveness, and enable sustained excellence.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience: Requires a Bachelor's degree and 4 – 6 years of related experience.

Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position.

Soft Skills:

  • Intermediate - Seeks to acquire knowledge in area of specialty
  • Intermediate - Ability to identify basic problems and procedural irregularities, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
  • Intermediate - Ability to work independently
  • Intermediate - Demonstrated analytical skills
  • Intermediate - Demonstrated project management skills
  • Intermediate - Demonstrates a high level of accuracy, even under pressure
  • Intermediate - Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills
  • Intermediate - Ability to communicate and make recommendations to upper management
  • Intermediate - Ability to drive multiple projects to successful completion

License/Certification:

  • CSSBB - Six Sigma Black Belt , Non-Black Belt certifications will be considered as well, preferred
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PMP) , SAFe LPM certification will be considered as well, preferred
  • Certified Project Management Professional (PMP)-PMI preferred
Pay Range: $102,900.00 - $190,500.00 per year

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act

raw.description:
Manager - Information Technology

About PSPSync

PSPSync Limited is a dynamic and growing provider of Patient Support Program (PSP) services, delivering innovative, technology-enabled solutions that simplify access to therapies for patients across Canada. We partner closely with healthcare providers, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical manufacturers to deliver patient-centric programs that improve outcomes while maintaining the highest standards of privacy, security, and compliance.

Position Summary

The Manager, Information Technology is responsible for leading technology workstreams and delivering strategic technology initiatives that support pharmaceutical manufacturers, Patient Support Programs (PSPs), and internal business operations.

This role serves as a key technology partner for clients and internal stakeholders, leading the implementation of new software applications, technology-enabled business processes, system enhancements, and technology components of new Patient Support Program launches. The Manager, Information Technology will oversee projects from requirements gathering and solution design through implementation, testing, change management, launch, and post-implementation support.

As a client-facing technology leader, this position is responsible for translating business and client requirements into practical technology solutions while ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and in accordance with organizational, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead technology workstreams for strategic client and organizational initiatives from planning through implementation and stabilization.
  • Manage technology components associated with the launch, expansion, transition, and enhancement of Patient Support Programs.
  • Lead the implementation and integration of new software applications, platforms, and technology solutions.
  • Develop project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables for assigned technology initiatives.
  • Coordinate activities across internal teams, clients, software vendors, implementation partners, and other external stakeholders.
  • Identify project risks, issues, and dependencies and develop appropriate mitigation and escalation strategies.
  • Ensure technology projects are delivered according to established scope, timelines, quality standards, and business requirements.
  • Provide regular project status reporting and communicate key decisions, risks, issues, and accomplishments to stakeholders.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a primary technology contact for pharmaceutical manufacturer clients on assigned projects and initiatives.
  • Lead client-facing technology discussions, requirements-gathering sessions, project meetings, solution reviews, and implementation updates.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business language for clients and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Partner with clients to understand business requirements, operational objectives, reporting needs, workflows, and technology expectations.
  • Build effective relationships with client technology teams, program stakeholders, vendors, and internal business leaders.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure timely communication regarding project scope, timelines, risks, changes, and decisions.

Business Analysis & Solution Design

  • Facilitate discovery sessions to identify and document business, functional, technical, integration, and reporting requirements.
  • Evaluate existing processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automation, data quality, user experience, and scalability through technology.
  • Translate business requirements into functional specifications, workflows, system configurations, and implementation requirements.
  • Collaborate with technical teams and vendors to assess solution feasibility and recommend appropriate technology approaches.
  • Ensure technology solutions support operational requirements while maintaining appropriate security, privacy, compliance, and data-management standards.

Software Implementation & Systems Management

  • Lead or coordinate system configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, validation, deployment, and production readiness activities.
  • Support the implementation and ongoing enhancement of business-critical platforms and applications.
  • Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test planning, defect management, issue resolution, and business sign-off.
  • Manage system enhancements and change requests from assessment and prioritization through implementation.
  • Work with vendors and internal technical resources to troubleshoot complex system and integration issues.
  • Ensure appropriate system documentation, configuration records, technical specifications, and support procedures are maintained.

Change Management & Process Improvement

  • Lead technology-related change management activities associated with new systems, processes, and program launches.
  • Assess the operational impact of technology changes and develop implementation and transition plans that minimize business disruption.
  • Partner with business leaders, operations, training, and other stakeholders to support user readiness and adoption.
  • Develop or coordinate system documentation, standard operating procedures, work instructions, training materials, and implementation communications.
  • Monitor post-launch adoption and performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Promote standardized, scalable, and sustainable technology and business processes across the organization.

Patient Support Program Technology

  • Support the technology design and implementation of new Patient Support Programs for pharmaceutical manufacturer clients.
  • Partner with program operations and client teams to translate program requirements into system workflows and technology solutions.
  • Support technology requirements related to patient enrollment, case management, reimbursement, communications, reporting, integrations, and other PSP workflows.
  • Coordinate technology readiness activities for program launches and significant program changes.
  • Ensure solutions appropriately support sensitive patient and healthcare information and applicable privacy and security requirements.
  • Participate in program launch readiness assessments and provide technology support during go-live and stabilization periods.

Technology Governance, Security & Compliance

  • Ensure technology initiatives follow organizational standards for security, privacy, documentation, change control, and system access.
  • Collaborate with security, privacy, compliance, quality, and business stakeholders to ensure technology solutions meet applicable requirements.
  • Support technology risk assessments, audits, client assessments, and remediation activities as required.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation and controls throughout the technology project lifecycle.
  • Support vendor evaluation and technology due diligence for new applications and service providers.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Project Management, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in information technology, technology project management, systems implementation, business systems, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex technology implementations and cross-functional projects.
  • Experience working directly with clients and managing technology-related client communications and expectations.
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into technology solutions.
  • Experience with software implementation, system configuration, integrations, testing/UAT, change management, and production deployment.
  • Experience managing external technology vendors and implementation partners.
  • Experience within pharmaceutical, healthcare, Patient Support Programs, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of Canadian healthcare privacy, data protection, and security considerations is an asset.
  • Project management certification such as PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2, or equivalent experience is an asset.
  • Change management certification or experience with formal change management methodologies is an asset.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

  • Strong technology project management and implementation skills.
  • Excellent client-facing communication and presentation abilities.
  • Strong business analysis, requirements gathering, and process-mapping capabilities.
  • Ability to translate between technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
  • Strong understanding of software implementation and system development lifecycles.
  • Ability to identify project and technology risks and develop practical mitigation strategies.
  • Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills.
  • High level of attention to detail and documentation.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Strong commitment to data privacy, security, quality, and regulatory compliance.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through change and influence stakeholders without direct authority

Please note: The Company does not use artificial intelligence in the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this position. This job posting relates to an existing vacancy.

Salary: $100,000 - $120,000

The Vice President or Senior Vice President of Business Development will drive new business growth by identifying, developing, and closing enterprise BPO, CX, and technology-enabled transformation opportunities with national and international companies. Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

  • Provide strategic guidance to internal teams regarding client priorities and business objectives.
  • Mentor junior Account Managers and contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

  • Proven experience managing enterprise or multinational client accounts across multiple countries.
  • Demonstrated success in client retention, renewals, upselling, cross-selling, and commercial account growth.
  • Strong commercial mindset with experience managing pricing discussions, scope changes, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent client-facing, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior executives.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex accounts while working collaboratively across global teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Experience within a global Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Employer of Record (EOR), Professional Employer Organization (PEO), Global Payroll, HR Services, or Business Corporate Services organization.
  • Experience supporting multinational organizations with international expansion.
  • Knowledge of US employment practices and international workforce solutions.
  • Experience participating in business development activities, including client meetings, networking events, and supporting go-to-market initiatives.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, global, matrix organization.

OVERVIEW

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

We Make Growing Your Career Possible

    • We operate with the benefits of a partnership without the complexities of a partnership. Our hybrid partnership-corporate model offers all employees the opportunity to become a partner, while maintaining a streamlined corporate structure so that decisions are made quickly.
    • We do not offer equity plans. As we are not for sale and are not chasing an exit, "stock options" hold little value in our business model. Instead, we provide opportunities for outstanding employees to make partner and share in the profits. We believe it's better to build lasting value than to chase a one-time payout.
    • We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way.
    • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations
    • English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world.
    • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success.
    • We keep things simple and collaborative. Our structure makes it easy for teams to work together across borders so we can serve our clients with global needs more effectively. Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership.
    • We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions.
    • We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. Forget rigid office routines - it's old school! This flexibility fuels productivity, strengthens our workforce, and ensures we remain agile in a fast-changing world.

raw.description:
Why Praxent?

We get it. You have options. Let us tell you why we’re different. Our work is changing the world of financial services. Everyday, clients arrive with big ideas for their industry. They’re experts in their field with the vision and resources you need to change everything. All that’s left is the right team to bring that vision to life. If you’re a fast learner and you love working on a wide variety of projects, you’re going to like it here. We help our clients modernize, rather than rebuild, outdated customer-facing software applications. Our clients see a return within weeks instead of months and that’s why they choose us.

At Praxent, we let you do your work your way. We’re a team of 200+ located throughout the United States and Central/South America. Our role is to encourage you, support you, and give you the freedom you need to thrive. Whether you’re working at home, in a coffee shop, or heck, even on your travels, we’re here to create an environment that lets you live your best life. On your terms.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live in the following locations: Mexico, Colombia, or El Salvador.

Your Mission: Enhance the team’s capacity to deliver assigned stories by end of sprint

  • Cultivate Camaraderie: Ensure that Core Values are living and breathing throughout the project team and that these values are reflected within the QA assurance team and department.
  • Increase Velocity: Perform automated testing and API testing for complex applications and scenarios; locate and document edge cases by understanding the depth and intricacies of a project; assess possible risks and propose modifications to the acceptance criteria.
  • Expand Frameworks: Demonstrate proficiency at automation, API testing, or accessibility testing principles and solutions.
  • Increase Velocity: Enhance the team's capacity by documenting plans to anticipated risks/blockers, advancing best practices, and mentoring peers and more junior team members.
  • Guide Development: Serve as a technical SME in the sprint, ensuring successful delivery of the sprint commitment by prioritizing testing efforts, enhancing acceptance criteria, etc.
  • Evaluate Skills: Conduct recruiting interviews and analyze candidates to ensure successful hiring/contracting.
  • Demonstrate Expertise: Present robust testing plans, metrics, and other valuable insight and direction during sprint review meetings; propose solutions and improvements to clients that improve our ability to deliver value.

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Key Activities: Ensuring the team understands acceptance criteria, tracking daily progress, limit team’s QA kickback, deliver stories as assigned, find opportunities to increase capacity and velocity.
  • How a Current Praxenter Describes The Role: “I spend a lot of the sprint planning and delegating technical work for other devs, anticipating how to deliver as much value for the client via efficiency and tech debt prevention. This has the added benefit of allow assigned devs to grow technically while also reducing as many unknowns as possible in the cone of uncertainty. It’s my job to keep in sync with delivery leads on priorities, team allocation, risks, etc, as well as act as the technical interface for the client to help guide them without overloading them with technical jargon.”

Your Qualifications:

  • Technical Proficiency: demonstrable proficiency with desired technologies and tools
    • Hands-on SQL: Genuine fluency writing complex T-SQL from scratch, since ~95% of the work is writing queries to validate data. Includes daily fundamentals like duplicates, joins, primary vs. surrogate keys, query execution order, and reconciliation.
    • ETL and data testing: Experience validating data source-to-target, including transformations, data completeness, and end-to-end flows against specs and mapping documents.
    • QA methodology: Solid grasp of test cases, test plans, test strategy, positive/negative testing, performance and load testing, and data completeness testing. This role sits between a data analyst and a QA tester, so strong SQL without QA discipline isn't a fit, and neither is QA without complex SQL.
    • BI and report testing (not building): Comfortable testing SSRS and Power BI output against your own SQL queries. Developers build the reports; you validate they're correct.
    • Microsoft SQL Server environment: Hands-on across SQL Server, data warehouse, SSRS, and Power BI.
    • Bonus points: Azure data sources, SSAS cubes, and version control. Deep Power BI/Fabric or modeling depth is a plus, not a substitute for daily SQL and QA fundamentals.
  • Practical Experience: 5-8 years professional experience in relevant technology and projects, including ongoing adherence of best practices, leading and executing automated testing for web and mobile applications, and leveraging industry-standard tools to ensure optimal product quality across all stages of the software development lifecycle.
  • Client Leadership: Experience presenting to client stakeholders and communicating technical and business value
  • Outcome Orientation: Experience understanding and articulating the business outcomes that your development projects impact
  • Mentorship Experience: Experience with coaching and mentoring, demonstrated through ad-hoc collaboration and structured code reviews.
  • Relevant Education: may include intensive programs, Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a equivalent experience
  • Values Alignment: We Care Deeply, Always Deliver, Never Settle, Do It Together, Own the Outcome, and approach every situation with a CAN DO mentality – learn more about our Core Values and be sure to let us know which aligns most with your experience!

What You’ll Love About Us:

  • A stable, full-time role. We’ve been building digital products for 25 years. This is a full-time employment opportunity in your country—offering paid time off, local holidays, and country-specific perks.
  • Work/life balance that’s real. We believe work should support your life, not take it over. That’s why we promote a true work/life balance and encourage a 40-hour work week—no more.
  • A culture worth joining. Praxent has been recognized by Best Places to Work in Fintech, Clutch, and Comparably for workplace excellence. Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor reviews to hear directly from our team.
  • Support without micromanagement. Your career is yours to grow. We’re here to guide, unblock, and champion you—not hover over your shoulder.
  • Your voice matters. Got an idea? A different perspective? We want to hear it. Our team is built on openness, curiosity, and shared ownership.
  • Time to recharge. You’ll receive paid time off and holidays based on your country’s standards because we believe work-life balance makes better people and better teams.
  • Local perks, global standards. You’ll receive country-specific benefits that reflect where you live—often including bonus pay, local protections, and perks that matter to you. We’ll walk you through all the details when we connect.
  • We invest in your growth. Whether it’s an online course, a tech conference, or a certification you’ve been eyeing—we cover the cost of ongoing learning. We want you to keep growing with us.
  • People-first always. At Praxent, you’re not a number. You’re a person. We lead with kindness, respect, and empathy—because work should feel like a place where you belong.

Who We Are:Corcym offers a complete portfolio of surgical solutions with a heritage spanning more than 50 years, leveraging on a complete and distinctive set of technologies, capabilities and infrastructure.

Our Vision:is to become the leading company dedicated to Heart Surgeons and their Patients by providing the best solutions to fight structural heart disease.

Our Mission:is to help Heart Surgeons treat Patients better today and in the future.

Senior Medical Affairs Specialist support the development, implementation and coordination of global educational programs in all geographies. Support the Medical Affairs team in strategic projects including internal continuous education programs, organization of international podium activities, key opinion leaders (KOLs) and proctors’ engagement plans.

This is a full remote position, but for specific company events is required to be in presence in our HQ in Saluggia (VC).

Essential Job Functions:

  • Support the creation of company-related scientific/clinical content, including external- and internal-facing materials and interpretation of incoming materials
  • Support the development of podium presentation strategy aligned with company strategy and in full compliance with regulation and transparency requirements
  • Contribute to developing a clinical strategy program for CORCYM products for existing and emerging applications
  • With the support of the team develops and manages robust programs for:

    • Clinician engagement for CORCYM products for existing and emerging applications
    • KOL relationship building and communication to support strategic objectives
    • KOL engagements including contracts, event management and invoice submission in full compliance with regulations and transparency requirements
    • KOL maps for compliant engagement to support strategic objectives
    • Selection, organization and communications for medical advisory board and
    • clinician round-table activities
    • Professional education (peer-to-peer activities, preceptorship programs, etc)
  • Act as the reference person for all international medical education programs, coordinating and building strong working relations with CORCYM Proctors in all the Geographies.
  • Support CORCYM presence at meetings for relevant medical societies by preparing and/or delivering presentations and engaging KOLs for content preparation and delivery
  • Support the management of medical education initiatives, provide support for related training activities including in-person events, virtual events, website content and electronic media, and provide clinical instruction for internal and external audiences
  • Act as medical affairs expert for product development

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Corcym is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports and respects all individuals in which personnel processes are merit-based and applied without discrimination on the basis of protected characteristics.

At Corcym, we uphold a set of Non-Negotiable behaviors that define how we work:

  • We never compromise on patient safety and our integrity. Patients are at the heart of everything we do.
  • We act like Founders and Owners We take ownership, we try new things, and we take results personally.
  • We always look for a better way. We do not accept “we have always done it this way” as a reason not to improve.
  • We eliminate all unnecessary complexity. Simplicity and common sense are better than unnecessary complexity and bureaucracy.
  • We focus on what matters. Concentration of energy is key to our success.
  • We enable the Surgeon of the Future (SOF). Our focus, insights, innovations, and loyalty are to the surgeons who can be the Surgeon of the Future.
  • We always aim for the highest Quality of Revenue (QOR). Our choices on accounts, actions and investments are driven by improving QOR.

raw.title: Terms of Reference: Travel Management Services for NESsT’s U.S.-Based Team
raw.excerpt: Engagement type: Independent contractor or travel management company Location: Remote; provider must be able to support U.
raw.description:
Engagement type: Independent contractor or travel management company

Location: Remote; provider must be able to support U.S.-based travelers

Initial term: One year, with the possibility of renewal

1. Organization Profile

NESsT is an international nonprofit organization operating across Latin America, Central and Eastern Europe, and the United States. NESsT invests in social enterprises that create dignified employment and sustainable income opportunities for people facing barriers to economic inclusion, while contributing to environmental sustainability. Through business support, catalytic capital, and long-term partnerships, NESsT helps social enterprises grow their impact and strengthen local economies.

2. Objective of the Engagement

The objective of this engagement is to establish a reliable travel management service that supports NESsT’s U.S.-based staff with domestic and international travel arrangements while ensuring traveler safety, operational efficiency, policy compliance, and prudent stewardship of organizational and donor resources.

4. Scope of Services

The selected provider will coordinate flights, accommodations, travel insurance, itineraries, booking changes, cancellations, and travel-related support for authorized NESsT travelers.

4.1 Air Travel

The provider will:

  • Research and present flight options that balance price, total travel time, number of connections, and traveler convenience.
  • Prioritize the most economical option that reasonably minimizes travel time and unnecessary connections.
  • Recommend fully or partially refundable tickets when the additional cost does not exceed approximately 30% of the ticket price.
  • Manage ticket issuance, schedule changes, rebookings, cancellations, and refund requests.
  • Monitor significant itinerary changes and promptly notify the traveler and designated NESsT contact.

4.2 Accommodation

The provider will:

  • Source and book practical, well-rated, and cost-effective accommodations close to the relevant event venue, office, or meeting location.
  • Generally propose hotels of up to three stars for single occupancy and four stars for double.
  • Keep hotel rates within NESsT’s approved travel limits (below 60% of the applicable U.S. Department of State foreign per diem lodging rate for the destination).
  • Clearly identify cancellation terms, taxes, fees, and any non-refundable conditions before booking.

4.3 Travel Insurance

  • Recommend appropriate insurance options for the destination and travel circumstances.
  • Present several alternatives when feasible, with a clear comparison of coverage, exclusions, and price.
  • Arrange coverage that includes, at a minimum, medical treatment for illness arising during travel, accidents requiring medical assistance, baggage loss, and expenses related to flight delays.
  • Issue and provide the relevant policy documentation before departure.

4.4 Traveler Support

The provider will:

  • Serve as the primary travel coordination contact before and during each trip.
  • Prepare and share clear itineraries and booking confirmations.
  • Assist with delays, cancellations, missed connections, and other disruptions.
  • Offer a clear escalation channel for urgent assistance outside standard business hours.

4.5 Billing and Administration

NESsT prefers periodic, consolidated invoicing and payment by bank transfer rather than payment by corporate credit card. The provider will:

  • Confirm its ability to invoice NESsT and accept payment by bank transfer.
  • Provide itemized invoices showing the traveler, itinerary, base cost, taxes, fees, service charges, credits, and refunds.
  • Provide supporting documentation for each transaction.
  • Maintain accurate records of bookings, changes, cancellations, credits, and unused tickets.
  • Coordinate with NESsT’s Operations and Finance teams on documentation and payment matters.

5. Provider Qualifications

Applicants should demonstrate:

  • At least three years of experience providing corporate or business travel management services.
  • Substantial experience arranging international travel.
  • Knowledge of airline fare structures, ticketing rules, refunds, exchanges, and travel logistics.
  • Experience arranging accommodations and travel insurance across multiple destinations.
  • The ability to support senior executives and frequent travelers.
  • Strong customer service, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
  • The systems and capacity to manage multiple concurrent travel requests accurately.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

Experience supporting nonprofit, international development, consulting, or other mission-driven organizations, and experience coordinating travel in Latin America and Europe, are preferred.

6. Contract Management

The provider will coordinate primarily with NESsT’s designated Operations contact and with authorized travelers. NESsT anticipates an initial one-year agreement, subject to satisfactory performance, continued organizational need, and mutual agreement. The final agreement will define applicable fees, invoicing arrangements, service standards, confidentiality obligations, data protection requirements, and termination provisions.

This Terms of Reference does not guarantee a minimum number or value of bookings. NESsT may modify the scope of services or discontinue the selection process at its discretion.

7. Submission Requirements

Interested companies or independent consultants should submit a concise proposal containing:

  • Provider profile: Legal name, location, years in operation, organizational structure, and primary contact details.
  • Relevant experience: Description of comparable corporate or international travel assignments, including experience supporting nonprofit or mission-driven organizations where applicable.
  • Service model: Booking workflow, approval process, communication channels, designated account support, backup coverage, and emergency support arrangements.
  • Service levels: Standard and urgent response times, hours of coverage, and escalation process.
  • Technology and reporting: Booking, traveler-profile, invoicing, expense-documentation, and reporting capabilities.
  • Financial proposal: All service, transaction, emergency, cancellation, change, implementation, and other applicable fees, together with invoicing terms and available payment methods.
  • Billing confirmation: Explicit confirmation of whether the provider can offer periodic invoicing and accept payment by bank transfer.
  • References: Contact details for three current or recent clients for comparable services.

8. Evaluation Criteria

Submissions will be assessed against the following criteria:

  • Relevant experience and qualifications.
  • Understanding of NESsT’s requirements.
  • Quality, practicality, and reliability of the proposed service model.
  • Responsiveness, traveler support, and emergency coverage.
  • Ability to provide transparent, invoice-based billing and accept payment by bank transfer.
  • Cost and overall value.
  • Quality of references.

9. Submission Instructions

Proposals should be submitted electronically in PDF format with the subject line Travel Management Services – Proposal.

Submission deadline: Oct 30, 2026

10. Equal Opportunity

NESsT is committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We welcome submissions from qualified businesses and consultants from diverse backgrounds and encourage participation by minority-owned, women-owned, veteran-owned, and other underrepresented businesses.

Note: Checek the complete description on our site.

If you have a strong background in DRG validation, inpatient auditing, and complex trauma coding, we encourage you to apply.

  • Active AHIMA or AAPC coding certification required.
  • CCS certification required.

  • Minimum of 3 years of recent APR-DRG/DRG coding experience in a Level II Trauma Center or higher.

  • Previous DRG/APR-DRG validation experience required.
  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM/PCS coding guidelines, MS-DRG/APR-DRG assignment, reimbursement methodologies, and documentation requirements.
  • Ability to identify coding opportunities, validate DRG assignment, and provide clear audit findings.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Must reside in the United States.

  • Competitive compensation
  • 401(k)
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Fully remote, direct-hire W-2 position
  • Long-term career growth with a family-owned company
